sp-08932.description_en: Allows the caster to research enchanted abilities to be placed in items.

sp-08934.description_en: Allows the caster to enchant a +5 bonus (magical) into a weapon.

sp-08935.description_en: As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted.

sp-08936.description_en: As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted. Also, items like spell adders and spell multipliers are described in Section 8.6.1.

sp-08938.description_en: As Weapon I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08939.description_en: As Armor I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08940.description_en: As General I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08942.description_en: As Weapon I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08943.description_en: As Armor I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08944.description_en: As General I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-07992.description_en: Creates a black, insubstantial wall up to 20' x 20' x l" that light cannot pass into or through (i.e., does not hinder movement, but it blocks vision).

sp-07993.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning airup to I O'x I O'x3 '. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-07994.description_en: As Light Wall, except for duration.

sp-07995.description_en: Creates a wall of water up to lO'xlO'xl'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.

sp-07996.description_en: Creates a wall of wood up to IO'x20'x2'. This wall can be burned though, chopped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

sp-07997.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of earth and has a size up to I O'x l O'x (3' at base, l' at top) of packed earth.

sp-08000.description_en: Opens a pit (500 cubic feet in stone; l 000 cuic feet in earth or ice). The entire pit must be within 50' of caster. A pit may not be opened except on a horizontal surface with an incline of Jess than 45'.

sp-08001.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of stone and has a size up to IO'x IO'x l '. It can be chipped through.

sp-08004.description_en: As Earth Wall, except for duration.

sp-08005.description_en: As lcewall l, except for area of effect.

sp-08007.description_en: Fuses 2 touching walls (must be of the same material; seam can be up to 20' long) or fuses a section of stone blocks (up to 100 cu').

sp-08008.description_en: Creates a wall out of the predominant ground material (grassy earth, sand, etc.) The wall may have dimensions of up to IO'xlOO'xl'. The wall has all of the physical properties of the ground it came from.

sp-08009.description_en: As any one of the lower level "wall" spells on this list (except Meld Walls), except the wall can be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-08010.description_en: As Meld Walls, except walls may be of dissimiliar type.

sp-08011.description_en: As Stonewall True, except the caster may create a freestanding structure with a total surface area ofup to 2000'.

sp-08012.description_en: As Groundwall, except for the duration.

sp-08013.description_en: By directly Channeling the power of his deity, the caster creates a transparent wall of "force" that is absolutely impassable by anyone or anything. It is up to IO'x20'x I".

sp-08014.description_en: As Wall ofForce, except for duration.

sp-08015.description_en: Exerts 1 pound of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone and pressure can only be in one direction.

sp-08017.description_en: Allows caster to move up and down vertically 1O' per round. The spell does not provide a means for horizontal movement.

sp-08018.description_en: As Staying I, except pressure limit is 25 pounds.

sp-08019.description_en: Target can fly at a rate of 100' per round (approximately 7 mph). While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g., walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.

sp-08021.description_en: As Levitation I, except rate is I 00' per round.

sp-08022.description_en: As Flying /, except rate is 300' per round (approximately 20 mph).

sp-08023.description_en: By concentrating on the mind of a missile firer and the flight of the missile, the caster causes +50 to be added to the attack roll of the missile. The caster must concentrate, touch the firer and the see the mssile for the entire round that the missile is fired.

sp-08024.description_en: The force of gravity is reduced by half in the target area. All falling damage is halved (round up). Moving maneuvers are suffer a special -25 penalty. Movement is limited to a jog pace within the area.

sp-08025.description_en: Caster may "hurl" one object (that starts within the range of the spell) of 5 pounds or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table (doing double normal concussion hits) with a maximum range of 300' (see Arms Law). The caster's 08 will equal his directed spell skill • bonus with this spell.

sp-08026.description_en: As Flying /, except rate is 50' per level of the caster.

sp-08027.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 20 pounds per level of the caster.

sp-08028.description_en: As Staying I, except pressure limit is 10 pounds per level of the caster.

sp-08029.description_en: The caster increases the gravity in the target area by threefold. All moving maneuvers, melee attacks, and missle attacks within the area suffer a special -50 penalty. Exhaustion points accrued while in the target area are doubled.

sp-08030.description_en: As Aiming, except caster can affect as many archers as he has levels. All archers (and their arrows) must be within range (and missiles) when the spell is cast.

sp-08031.description_en: As Hurling II, except weight limit is 50 pounds, the attack delivers four times normal concussion damage, and the attack has a special +50 modifier.

sp-08033.description_en: As Flying I, except affects as many targets as the caster has levels (all targets must be within range 6f the spell).

sp-08034.description_en: Target is surrounded by an intense magnetic field (that attracts all ferrous material). Any metal objects within 20' of the target must make an RR or be attracted to the target (possibly resulting in a Bash attack on the target). If the target is wearing metal armor, he suffers a -25 penalty to all moving maneuvers. Any melee attacks with 20' of the target suffer a special -25 penalty (and have their fumble ranges quadrupled). Missile attacks aimed at the target have a +25 bonus to their 08 (if they are at least partially ferrous). Any other missile attacks that pass within 20' of the target suffer a 25 penalty to their OB.

sp-08035.description_en: As Aiming, except attack automatically hits (doing maximum damage). In addition, if the attack was against a creature that takes Large or Super-Large criticals, the attack is resolved as a Slaying attack.

sp-08036.description_en: The target object begins attracting all material (regardless of its compositionI) within 50'. Any loose items within the 50' of the target begin flying towards him (and are crushed upon impact). The target takes dlO 'A' Impact criticals each round. Any other person within 50' of the target must make an RR each round (versus the level of this spell) to avoid taking an 'A' Impact critical.

sp-08038.description_en: Target can see I 00' ona clear night as if it were day. At least some small amount of residual light is required for this psell to work. See Section 7.1.19 (in Spell Law) for more on the environment's effect on vision.

sp-08039.description_en: Target's step is muffled. This results in a special +25 bonus to all Stalking maneuvers.

sp-08040.description_en: Target gains extremely acute sense of smell. This spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only smell (+25 to maneuvers involving smell and other senses).

sp-08041.description_en: As Nightvision, except affects vision underwater (and other liquids).

sp-08042.description_en: Target gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a bonus to all actions that require a sense of touch. For example, target might receive +25 to picking locks, disarming traps, opening secret doors, etc. In addition, this spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only touch (+25 to maneuvers involving touch and other senses).

sp-08043.description_en: Target gains extremely accurate sense of vision. This spell confers a special +50 bonus to all Awareness maneuvers involving only vision (+25 to maneuvers involving vision and other senses).

sp-08044.description_en: As Nightvision, except no light source is required and target can see even in magically created darkness.

sp-08045.description_en: As Scent, except target can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rain storms, through snow, etc.).

sp-08046.description_en: Target can see in any brightness of light (including that which would normally be blinding or glaring). This spell does not work in the absence of light.

sp-08047.description_en: Target gains extreme sensitivity to vibrations in the ground (or other solid material; up to the area of effect). Target gains information indicating general movements and number of targets (± I 0% ). Treat as a +25 to + 100 bonus to Awareness maneuvers (depending on the type of activity).

sp-08048.description_en: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe any air, water, and/or gas at will.

sp-08049.description_en: As Nightvision, except range of vision is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-08050.description_en: For the duration of the spell, all illusions within range of the spell cease to exist for the target. Target need not be aware of any illusions within the range before casting this spell.

sp-08051.description_en: · - Target's skin has the resilience of a minor drake (effective AT of 12).

sp-08052.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any poisons in the body of the target (at the time of the casting) will not affect the target. For the duration of this spell, the target cannot be the target of further Stop Poison spells.

sp-08053.description_en: Target has the effects of Sly Ears, Scent, Touch, and Sharp Eyes spells simultaneously.

sp-08054.description_en: Target can "merge" his senses with those of a subject whose exact location is known. Exact location can be established through a prior arrangement. If the subject is not at the specified location, the PPs for this spell are still expended.

sp-08055.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-08057.description_en: Target is surrounded by a magnetic field, repelling all ferrous objects. Missile attacks passing within 20' of the target have 50 subtracted from their attack (presuming the missile is at least partially ferrous in nature). Melee attacks against the target suffer a special -25 penalty to their attack (presuming the weapon is at least partially ferrous). If the target is wearing metal armor, he will have a penalty of -25 to all moving maneuvers (this same penalty will apply to all maneuvers using metal objects).

sp-08058.description_en: As Shielding, except for the duration.

sp-08059.description_en: Temporarily enchants the target's clothing, armor, or shield, conferring a+ I O DB bonus.

sp-08060.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes with I 00' of him (he must be able to see the missile and the missile must be within range). This causes I 00 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-08061.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-08062.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can deflect one missile attack per round (the caster must concentrate to cause the deflection). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-08063.description_en: As Deflections, except the caster may deflect up to 2 missiles.

sp-08064.description_en: I - Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes this missile to automatically miss its target.

sp-08065.description_en: As Bladetum, except the caster may block 2 attacks.

sp-08066.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can deflect one melee attack per round (the caster must concentrate to cause the deflection). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-08067.description_en: Caster can deflect any one elemental that passes with 100' of him (he mu$t be able to see the spell effect and the effect must be within range). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-08068.description_en: As Aim Untrue I, exceptthecastermaystop up to 2 missle attacks.

sp-08069.description_en: As Deflections I, except the caster may deflect up to his level in missile attacks.

sp-08070.description_en: One missle attack passing within 100' of the caster is reversed upon its source, attacking it with an OB of +5.

sp-08071.description_en: As Spell Deflect/, except affects up to two spells.

sp-08072.description_en: As Bladetum I, except that the caster may block up to his level in melee attacks.

sp-08073.description_en: As Aim Untrue I, except that the caster may stop up to his level in missle attacks.

sp-08074.description_en: The caster temporarily enchants a target garment to protect as AT 4.

sp-08075.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can deflect one elemental spell attack per round (the caster must concentrate to cause the deflection). This causes I 00 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-08076.description_en: As Re-Aiming, except that all missle attacks passing within I 00' of the caster are reflected back upon their source(s) with a bonus of +20.

sp-08077.description_en: As Deflect I, Bladetum I, and Spell Deflect /; except any 3 attacks can be deflected.

sp-08078.description_en: As Arcane Armor, except the garment protects as AT 12.

sp-08080.description_en: Caster can remove one Sign I (an emplaced 1st level spell). The Sign's RR is based upon the level of the spell in the Sign (the target level) and the level of the Unsign spell (the attack level).

sp-08081.description_en: Target sign will not trigger for the duration of this spell. This spell may only be cast upon any given sign once per day.

sp-08082.description_en: Caster can emplace one I st level spell on any inanimate object (see below). Within one minute, the spell to be emplaced must also be cast (within 10' of the sign). The symbol is usually visable, but is only required to be visible if reading is the trigger (see below). • The Sign must be placed on an inanimate object of a size relative to the level of the spell. The object must be either I 0 square inches per level of the spell or weigh I 0 pounds per level of the spell. • A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by the caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is normally I 0' or the range of the em placed spell, whichever is larger. • If the spell emplaced is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell' s level (not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normall +0. However, the attack can be focussed on a location (as opposed to simply the person who triggers the symbol). In this case, the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Sign affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered only once per day.

sp-08083.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign I, except instead of imbedding a spell, the Sign itself affects a target character (trigger effects determined upon imbedding). Target character is limited to 60% activity for I minute per 10 failure.

sp-08084.description_en: As Sign I, except up to a 3rd level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08085.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target suffers a -30 to all actions for I minute per 10 failure.

sp-08086.description_en: As Unsign I, except will remove up to a Sign Ill, or a Sign of Hesitation, or a Sign of Confusion.

sp-08087.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target is put into a state of shock for 10 minutes per 10 failure (treat as if target is stunned, except target will never pass out due to this shock).

sp-08088.description_en: As Sign /, except up to a 5th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08089.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target will flee the location of the Sign for 1 minute per 5 failure. The target must make his RR based upon his resistance to Essence (not his resistance to Fear).

sp-08090.description_en: As Unsign I, except will remove up to a Sign V, a Sign of Fear, or Sign of Shock.

sp-08091.description_en: As Sign ofHesitation, except target falls into a magical sleep from which he cannot be awakened for 10 minutes per 10 failure.

sp-08093.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is . blinded for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-08095.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is paralyzed for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-08096.description_en: As Sign I, except up to a 10th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08097.description_en: As any Sign spell, except may affect a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-08098.description_en: As Unsign I, except any lower level Sign spell may be removed.

sp-08099.description_en: As Sign of Hesitation, except target is is killed if he fails his RR.

sp-08100.description_en: As Sign I, except any level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08101.description_en: As Unsign True, except a number of Signs may be removed equal to the caster's level.

sp-08103.description_en: Detects any active spell or item and reports the realm to the caster. Caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-08104.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster is aware of all sentient/thinking beings within the area of effect.

sp-08105.description_en: As Detet Magic, except detects living beings.

sp-08106.description_en: As Detect Magic, except detects invisible things. All attacks against an invisible target suffera -50 penalty (instead of the standard-JOO). See Section 7.1.10 (in Spell Law) for more on Invisibility. •

sp-08107.description_en: As Detect Magic, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication may reduce or enhance this chance). See Section 7 .1.28 (in Spell Law) for information on trap complexity.

sp-08108.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any I dead target (though the eyes of the deceased). He also gets a view of the killer (if any). The caster must be within I O' of the corpse. Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster's level.

sp-08109.description_en: Caster can check one object or place (up to 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion put upon it.

sp-08110.description_en: As Detect Magic, except will give an approximate level of the power in the item or spell examined. JO. Power Typing - As Detect Magic, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or spell cast) and what spell list it was cast from. In the case of a person, it gives his exact profession.

sp-08112.description_en: Gives the direction an distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have teh dimensions of the object exact within 10% of the actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributers to make the item unique.

sp-08113.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next 10 minutes if a specific event takes place (e.g., if this door is opened).

sp-08114.description_en: As Lesser Analysis, except there is no limit on the age of the target and this spell may be used on organic objects (including people). When used on a living target, it will reveal race, culture, age, and general state of health.

sp-08115.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except for the range.

sp-08117.description_en: As Location, except for the range.

sp-08118.description_en: As any single Detect spell above, except for the range.

sp-08119.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except for the range.

sp-08120.description_en: As Greater Analysis, except works only on living beings. Provides a detailed analysis of the target (specific age, parentage, health, outlook, etc.).

sp-08122.description_en: As Location, except for the range.

sp-08123.description_en: As any of the lower level spells on this list simultaneously (except those with a duration of"-").

sp-08147.description_en: Caster is aware of all sources of power (nodes, pools, Waiting stores, deities, etc.) within 50'. Caster knows distance and direction.

sp-08148.description_en: Caster becomes aware of the nature (good, evil, chaotic, orderly, etc.) and amount of power in a detected source. Caster also learns of the division of the species of the source.

sp-08149.description_en: When this spell is cast, the first level spell that the caster begins to cast next round will be "channeled" to another spell user. The "channeled" spell is transmitted to the other spell caster when it would normally take effect, and must be used immediately (i.e., the recipient is treat~s the one who had cast the spell). All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of Channels must be able to see the recipient of the spell or know exactly where the recipient is (direction and distance, or specific location). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (though he need not know exactly what spell is coming).

sp-08150.description_en: Caster temporarily imbeds power into an item (which he may later tap as a source of power with a Tap Source spell). This item is known as a Store. The spell stores one power point (PP) per level of the caster into an item. The stored PPs must be expended at the time this spell is cast. Typically, the item must be specially constructed of crystalline stone. The stone must be at least one ounce (in weight) per PP to be stored. A given caster may only have one Store at a time.

sp-08153.description_en: As Sense Power I, except for the area of effect.

sp-08154.description_en: As Power Storage I, except stores 2 PPs per level. I0. Power Merge - Allows two spell casters to interchange PPs. Caster and target must be able to see each other.

sp-08157.description_en: I-As Tap Source I, except rate is 3 PPs per minute.

sp-08158.description_en: As Power Storage I, except stores 3 PPs per level.

sp-08160.description_en: As Sense Power I, except for the area of effect.

sp-08161.description_en: As Power Storage/, excpet stores 4 PPs per level.

sp-08163.description_en: As Tap Source I, except rate is 5 PPs per minute.

sp-08164.description_en: As Channels I, except up to twentieth level spells may be transmitted.

sp-08165.description_en: As Tap Source I, except rate of absorbtion is 1 PP per round.

sp-08167.description_en: When any spell is thrown on the caster of this spell, the attacking spell must make a RR successfully before the caster must make one. The RR is vs a level equal to the level of the defending character, compared against the level of the casterof the attacking spell. If the first RR is successful ,the spell proceeds as normal.

sp-08168.description_en: As Detect Magic I, except caster learns realm, type, and profession of the spell caster.

sp-08169.description_en: This spell will reveal the realm of and type (information, force, etc.) of any spell cast that was previously within the area of effect (up to one hour per level of the caster in the past).

sp-08170.description_en: Caster studies an active spell for use with the Three Realms spells. Runes may also be studied. A given caster can only have as many spells "studied" as he has levels. A spell with no duration cannot be studied.

sp-08171.description_en: As Detect Magic I, except also gives the exact number of PPs spent in casting the spell and the exact name of the spell. I 0. Three Realms III - Caster is able to simulate the effects of any previously studied (using study spell) Open or Closed spell (of any realm) up to third level.

sp-08173.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] An active spell must make a RR or be dispelled. Spells resist with their caster's level versus the level of the Dispel caster.

sp-08174.description_en: Creates an intangible wall incorporating any spell of no greater than 8th level within the following limitations: the incorporated spell must not create any material outside of the wall; the incorporated spell may not remove things from the wall; the incorporated spell may not target specific locations; anything passing through the wall are effected by the spell that is incorporated into the wall (RRs may be applicable).

sp-08175.description_en: Creates a wall of a specific elemental (specified when the spell is cast). Anything passing through the wall suffers a 'B' severity critical of the appropriate type.

sp-08176.description_en: When cast upon a target, this spell prevents that target from channeling (sending or receiving) spells or PPs (from either spells or skills). The incoming (or outgoing) spells must make an RR versus the level of the caster of Block Channel (using their caster's level) or they will fail.

sp-08177.description_en: Target loses all remaining PPs for 24 hours and cannot cast any spells for 24 hours (including any spells or PPs derived from bonus items).

sp-08178.description_en: Any spells cast by caster may appear to be of any type that he desires (for the purposes of of detections, divinations, etc.).

sp-08179.description_en: All targets of spells cast by the caster have their RRs modified by -25.

sp-08180.description_en: As Three Realms III, except spells up to sixth level may be simulated.

sp-08181.description_en: As Spell Masking I, except that the caster may select any realm and profession of caster (for the purposes of detections and divinations).

sp-08182.description_en: As Three Realms III, except spells up to tenth level may be simulated.

sp-08183.description_en: As Spell Masking II, except may also appear as any spell the caster knows.

sp-08184.description_en: Allows the use of all lower level spells on this list, one spell per round.

sp-08185.description_en: Caster knows the direction, and distance to any inhibition zones within the area of effect. The caster receives no specific information on the nature of the spell inhibition.

sp-08186.description_en: Caster creates an inhibition zone, preventing the casting of spells from a specific spell list. This spell prevents the casting of up to second level spells from the specified spell list.

sp-08187.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08188.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08189.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to fourth level are prevented.

sp-08190.description_en: As Spell Inhibition IV, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08191.description_en: _:.. As Spell Inhibition IV, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08192.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to sixth level are prevented.

sp-08193.description_en: As Spell Inhibition VJ, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08194.description_en: As Spell Inhibition VI, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08195.description_en: As Spell Inhibition II, except spells up to tenth level are prevented.

sp-08196.description_en: As Spell Inhibition True, except that a whole realm of magic is affected by the inhibition.

sp-08197.description_en: As Spell Inhibition True, except that spells from any realm are affected.

sp-08201.description_en: This spell must be cast within one minute after a target receives a Trigger spell. The stored spell will now be triggered by a specified sense (e.g., when you hear a bell, when you taste apples, when you smell fresh bread, etc.). The sense must be detectable at a distance no greater than I O' from the target. The sense can only be specified as accurately as the target can perceive it with the specified sense. For example, the trigger could react to a bell ringing, but not to a specific bell ringing (unless that bell were somehow unique in its sound). When the specified condition exists within 50', the target must make an Alertness maneuver (with a +50) modifier. Success indicates that the spell is triggered.

sp-08202.description_en: This spell must be cast within one minute after a target receives a Trigger spell. The stored spell will now be triggered after the duration of the Time Delay spell expires (replacing any previous triggers).

sp-08204.description_en: As Trigger V, except that higher level spells may be imbedded .

sp-08205.description_en: If cast upon a target who has a stored spell in him (stored with a Trigger spell), that target may cast spells without cancelling the stored spell.

sp-08206.description_en: As Sense Trigger I, except two different triggering sense may be designated (e.g., when you hear a bell chime or when someone says "Justice", or when you taste ale or when someone claps their hands, etc.).

sp-08207.description_en: As Time Delay/, except for duration.

sp-08200.description_en: The next spell cast by the caster will be stored in the target (must be cast within one minute after completing this spell). The target cannot cast any spells until this spell is triggered, or the stored spell will be lost. The stored spell is triggered by a specific action of the target (chosen at the time this spell is cast). The following restrictions apply to the spell stored in the target: • The level of the stored spell cannot exceed the level of the Trigger spell or the level of the target (whichever is lower). • No more than one spell may be placed in a given target. • If the spell stored is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell' s level (not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normally +0. If the spell has not triggered within 24 hours, the target may make another RR (with a +5 modifier). This continues each day (with the +5 modifier being cumulative) until the spell is resisted or until the spell is triggered.

sp-08208.description_en: As Trigger V, except higher level spells may be stored.

sp-08210.description_en: As Sense Trigger I, except up to five different triggers may be designated.

sp-08211.description_en: As Time Delay I, except for duration.

sp-08213.description_en: As Trigger V, except the highest level spell that may be stored is equal to 20 (or the level of the target, whichever is lesser).

sp-08214.description_en: As Trigger True, except that the level of the target does not limit the spell stored.

sp-08239.description_en: Caster gains knowledge of severity and nature of all of target's wounds.

sp-08240.description_en: Caster can preserve any "dead" body (or body part), prevent further deterioration (i.e., slat deteroriation) or damage from already existing wounds. If the target is a body, the target will be in a coma (this spell will not prevent the target's soul from leaving the body). S. Cosmetic Healing - Removes one scar from the target.

sp-08242.description_en: Caster can prevent the soul of a "dead" body from leaving its body (thus preventing actual death and enabling the fallen being to be restored via simple body repairs). This spell must be cast before the soul leaves the body.

sp-08243.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on target's wound that is bleeding up to S hits per round. For one hour, the target may not be moved or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-08244.description_en: Creates a temporary replacement for any single damaged or destroyed organ. For the organ to actually function, the caster must be touching the target and concentrating.

sp-08245.description_en: Cures all hits caused by frostbite or bums.

sp-08246.description_en: Completely repairs one simple or compound fracture (but not shatters), one damaged cartilage, or one damaged blood vessel.

sp-08247.description_en: As Lifekeeping Ill, except for duration.

sp-08248.description_en: Caster can remove an one disease from the target.

sp-08249.description_en: Mends one damaged or tom muscle or tendon.

sp-08250.description_en: Reattaches one severed limb (not the head).

sp-08251.description_en: Caster can remove an one poison from the target.

sp-08252.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding from one wound that is bleeding a number of hits per round equal to the caster's level.

sp-08253.description_en: As Lifekeeping I, except for duration.

sp-08254.description_en: Regenerates damaged and destroyed parts of the peripheral nervous system (not the spinal cord or brain).

sp-08256.description_en: Target's concussion hits are replenished to his normal maximum level.

sp-08257.description_en: Target regenerates a single damaged or destroyed organ. This process takes 1 day. SO. Full Regeneration - Target regenerates all damage. Time for regeneration is 10-100 days.

sp-08260.description_en: As Summons I, except that the caster choose two of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled. The same option may be chosen more than once.

sp-08261.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 5 options are chosen.

sp-08262.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 7 options are chosen.

sp-08263.description_en: The caster may communicate with any creatures he has summoned (prior to casting this spell). This ability ends when the duration of the summoning spell (for that creature) expires.

sp-08264.description_en: Caster issues a magical summons the nearest intelligent fantastic creature of no greater level than

sp-08265.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 10 options are chosen.

sp-08266.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 12 options are chosen.

sp-08267.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 15 options are chosen.

sp-08268.description_en: As Fantastic Summons Ill, except that the creature may be up to 6th level and it will attempt to answer the summons for six days.

sp-08269.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 20 options are chosen.

sp-08270.description_en: A single being with whom the caster is familiar (must know the being's name and be able to describe him uniquely) is compelled to journey to the caster's home. If the being cannot arrive at the caster's home within I day per level of the caster, the being will no longer be compelled to go there. Note that there are no reprocussions for ignoring the calling (though the target will be constantly reminded of the calling until the duration expires).

sp-08271.description_en: As Summons Ill, except one option per level of the caster is chosen.

sp-08272.description_en: As Fantastic Summons Ill, except that the creature may be up to 10th level and he will attempt to reach the caster for up to 10 days.

sp-08273.description_en: As Summons Ill, except that all creatures of the specified type in the area will attempt to answer the summons.

sp-08274.description_en: Caster opens a gate to the location of a specified target. If the target makes his RR, the gate will still opea (but will be displaced by I mile per level of the target). If the target fails his RR, he will be brought through the gate to the caster's location. The caster must be able to uniquely identify the target (including his name).

sp-08275.description_en: As Fantastic Summons Ill, except that the creature may be up to 20th level and he will attempt to reach the caster for up to 20 days.

sp-08276.description_en: I - Caster gains insight into important events in the very recent past of a place or an item. The caster will see the most significant events in the item's past (the past is defined as 1 hour per level of the caster). The caster will see one event for every five levels of experience. The importance of the events is only measured with respect to the time period viewed (not in the absolute history of the item or place).

sp-08277.description_en: Gives the area oforigin of the item, the race of the being who created it, and when it was made (within 100 years).

sp-08278.description_en: Caster learns the cause of death, the instrument(s) used to cause death, and the time of death of a single dead body (must be within 10' of the body). Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster's level.

sp-08279.description_en: One of the caster's senses is moved to a point up to 100' distant (ignoring intervening barriers). The exact distance must be specified when the spell is cast. Once the sense is placed, it may not move, but may rotate. If the caster has access to sense affecting spells, the projected sense may use these as well.

sp-08280.description_en: As Retrocognition I, excpet that the past is defined as I day per level of the caster.

sp-08283.description_en: Caster may cause a number of targets equal to his level to perceive what he senses with either along Sense or Scrying spell.

sp-08285.description_en: As Long Sense Ill, except that caster may project all five senses.

sp-08286.description_en: Caster transfers one of his sense into an inanimate object. While the object contains the sense, the caster can only sense through the object (regardless of the range to the object). The caster may end the spell at any time (up to the proscribed duration), but the sense is not restored until the caster touches the object.

sp-08288.description_en: As Death's Delving, except that caster learns exact circumstances and sees tha face of the killer.

sp-08289.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is five dreams pernight on different topics.

sp-08290.description_en: Caster gains momentary insights into the future. This results in +25 to all maneuvers, 08, and DB for the duration.

sp-08292.description_en: As Scrying, except that the range is I 0 miles per level of the caster. SO. Scrying True -As Scrying, except that range is 100 miles per level of the caster, no medium is needed, and all senses may be used.

sp-08295.description_en: The target's aura becomes visible and brightly illuminated. This makes the target seem more powerful, subtracting I O from all attacks against the target.

sp-08296.description_en: The caster receives specific information about the target's aura. This information includes whether the target views the caster as a friend or foe, the general skills of the target, and his general demeanor.

sp-08297.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] All who come within 10' of the target must make an RR Failure indicates that the person is confused for I round per I 0% failure. While confused, a person is limited to 50% activity (though he will always defend himself as if at I 00% activity).

sp-08298.description_en: The caster combines the effects of a first level spell with the target's aura. All who come into physical contact with the target are affected by the spell (though the target is never affected). Only spells with an area ofeffect of I target and a range of touch may be combined with an aura.

sp-08299.description_en: The target is surrounded by light, his aura visible for all to see. All attacks on target subtract 15. I 0. Hide Aura - The caster's aura cannot be viewed.

sp-08301.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] As Aura ofConfusion except victims failing their RR are under the effects of Fear for I round per I0% failure.

sp-08302.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to a third level spell may be used.

sp-08303.description_en: As Aura, except target has a great holy presence and attacks subtract 25 .

sp-08304.description_en: Caster alters his aura, changing its appearance however he likes.

sp-08305.description_en: As Aura of Fear, except there is no RR modification and the radius is 20'.

sp-08306.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to fifth level spells may be used.

sp-08307.description_en: As Alter Aura, except may be used on other targets (not just the caster).

sp-08308.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Aura ofFear, except that radius is 50'.

sp-08309.description_en: As Spell Aura I, except that up to tenth level spells may be used.

sp-08310.description_en: As Aura, except that caster seems as a deity. Attacks against the caster are at -45.

sp-08315.description_en: Creates a Size II bladerune. All 08 committed to parrying a single opponent is applied to all opponents.

sp-08316.description_en: Creates a Size II bladerune. As Spell /, except imbeds up to a second level spell into the Bladerune.

sp-08317.description_en: Any two bladerunes (on the same item) are linked, allowing them to be triggered at the same time.

sp-08318.description_en: Creates a Size III bladerune. As Spell I, except imbeds up to a third level spell into the bladerune.

sp-08320.description_en: Creates a Size III bladerune. May only be applied to missile weapons or thrown weapons Long range for the weapon is quadrupled (x4). Normal range penalties still apply.

sp-08321.description_en: Creates a Size IV bladerune. As Spell I, except imbeds up to a fifth level spell into the bladerune. IS. Weapon III - Creates a Size IV bladerune. As Weapon I, except bonus is +30

sp-08323.description_en: Creates a Size V bladerune. When activated, the object teleports to a specific location.

sp-08324.description_en: Creates a Size V bladerune. As Spell/, except imbeds up to a seventh level spell into a Bladerune.

sp-08325.description_en: Creates a Size V bladerune. When activated, bathes item in Element (element must be chosen at the time of the creation of the bladerune). Contact inflicts an appropriate 'B' critical. Attacking with an affected weapon inflicts an second critical (of equal severity) of the appropriate type.

sp-08326.description_en: As Comlpex Rune II, except links three bladerunes.

sp-08327.description_en: Creates a Size VI bladerune. When placed on a weapon, the weapon will leap from the wielder's hand (when activated) and attack target of wielder's choice. 08 for the attack is half the previous wielder's OB. When placed on a shield, the shield will interpose between attackers and wielder (giving the full effect for the shield without occupying a hand). When placed upon any other object, the item will place itself in between the wielder and any attackers (giving a +5 DB to the wielder). After activating the object will "dance" for as many rounds as the wielder has levels.

sp-08328.description_en: Creates a Size VI bladerune. Weapon is treated as "slaying" against a very specific race or class of creatures (type II demons, wood elves, lesser cyclops, etc.).

sp-08329.description_en: Creates a Size VII bladerune. As Spell I, except imbeds a spell of up to tenth level into a bladerune.

sp-08366.description_en: A I' diameter ball of fire shoots from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 20'R area. Resolve the attack on the Fire Ball Attack Table (in Spell Law).

sp-08367.description_en: As Fire Wall, except "wall" is 10' high and forms a 10' R circle with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-08368.description_en: Small balls of flame rain down in the area of effect. All within (or passing through) the area take a 'B' Heat Critical.

sp-08369.description_en: Caster bursts into flames. As long as the caster concentrates, he is immune to any damage from the fire (loss of concentration results in a 'D' Heat Critical each round until concentration can be regained). All within 5' of the caster suffer a 'B' Heat Critical (no RR), and all that come into contact with the caster suffer a 'D' Heat Critical (no RR).

sp-08371.description_en: The area of effect is bathed in intense fire. All within the area (or passing through) take a 'B' Heat Critical. All flammable objects are now burning. The caster can control the intensity of the fire by concentrating (once per round one target in the area must take a 'D' Heat Critical).

sp-08372.description_en: As Bum I, except completely inflammable materials catch fire (asbestoe, stone, etc.). The caster must concentrate of the burning will cease.

sp-08373.description_en: As Raze, except that the caster may increase the area by 50' per minute if he concentrates. In addition, the caster can choose to make himself immune to the heat (though this requires 100% activity from the caster).

sp-08360.description_en: Thecastercauses all burning within the area of effect to stop.

sp-08361.description_en: As Bum I, except will affect a substance that is somewhat flammable (cloth, paper, etc.).

sp-08362.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of fire. Anyone passing through it takes an 'A' Heat critical (no RR).

sp-08363.description_en: A bolt offire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attacks on the Fire Bolt Attack Table (in Spell Law). I 0. Burn III-As Bum I, except will affect a slighly flammable substance (wood, tar, etc.) and concentration is required to continue burning (if concentration is ' ceased, the object will cease to bum).

sp-08398.description_en: Creates an ~\imple, immobile image or scene up to an area of I0'R

sp-08399.description_en: A single object is made invisible (l garment, I naked body, etc.); until 24 hours pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-08401.description_en: As Unseen/, except everything within I foot of target is invisible, barring terrain.

sp-08402.description_en: Lights a 50'R about the point touched. If the point isonamobileobjectorbeing, it will move with the object/being. See Section 7.1.17 (in Spell law).

sp-08404.description_en: As Light V, except radius is as dark night.

sp-08406.description_en: As Invisibility I, except radius is 10'.

sp-08407.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table (in Spell law).

sp-08408.description_en: As Light V, except radius is 100' and the light also nullifies all magically created darkness. Any magical darkness inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-08409.description_en: As Dark V, except radius is 100' and no nonmagical light can exist inside. Any magical light inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-08410.description_en: As Light Mirage I, except for the area of effect.

sp-08411.description_en: Target appears to be offset from where he really is. All attacks have no effect 30% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance of"no effect" goes down by 5%.

sp-08412.description_en: As Light V, except for the area of effect.

sp-08413.description_en: ness - As Dark V, except for the area of effect.

sp-08414.description_en: As Invisibility I, except if the target attacks, he is only visible for the round immediately following the attack. Voilent blows do not affect this spell.

sp-08415.description_en: Caster gains +50 to all Lore maneuvers involving plants for as long as he concentrates and has an example of that plant in his possession.

sp-08416.description_en: As Flora Lore, except that the bonus applies to animals and that the caster must have sight of the animal in question.

sp-08417.description_en: Creates a thick, pea soup-like fog, reducing visibility to 5'.

sp-08418.description_en: II- Plants within area grow at 10 times their normal rate for duration.

sp-08419.description_en: Caster may alter the appearance or enhance the assets of a single plant. This allows tha caster to mold a plant into any shape within the size constraints of the plant. The plant will continue to mature along the path of its new form. The caster may also double the effectiveness of an enchanted plant (herbs, poisons, etc.) or make edible plants have twice the nutritional value.

sp-08420.description_en: Calls forth light precipitation appropriate to the prevailing weather patterns.

sp-08421.description_en: Caster gains foreknowledge of the weather in the area for the next 24 hours.

sp-08422.description_en: A single plant doubles in size in a single day. The mature plant will be 10% larger than normal.

sp-08423.description_en: Caster summons forth a stiff breeze (I 0-20 mph). The wind will come from whatever direction the prevailing winds usually come from .

sp-08424.description_en: Caster may alter a single behavioral trait of a single animal (herbivore to carnivore, pack animal to solitary, etc.). Does not give the animal the ability to deal with it's new condition, only the drive (a Cow converted to a carnivorous pattern will kill to eat, but does noe gain the ability to digest or chew the meat).

sp-08425.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, but the knowledge is for 7 days.

sp-08426.description_en: Caster summons a heavy rpecipitation ( I inch per hour) appropriate to the area.

sp-08427.description_en: As Speed Growth I, except for the area.

sp-08428.description_en: Caster creates a small but very powerful windstorm. Storm moves randomly about. All struck by, or within, the Cyclone receive a 'D' Impact critical and are thrown dlO feet from their present position, away from the cyclone.

sp-08429.description_en: As Plant Alteration or Alter Behavior, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-08431.description_en: Caster may call forth a storm of any type with maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to the circumstance (and the GM's discretion).

sp-08434.description_en: Caster stores the location of the node that he currently occupies (for use with other spells on this list).

sp-08435.description_en: Caster becomes aware of all animate activity within the boundaries of a node that he both occupies and has "stored" (see Store Node).

sp-08437.description_en: Caster is teleported to any place within the node he occupies.

sp-08438.description_en: As Node Summons V, except that ten levels are summoned.

sp-08439.description_en: The caster becomes aware of the direction of the nearest Node within one mile per level of the caster. This spell will not reveal a Minor Earthnode unless the caster has "stored" the node (see Store Node). If the caster has stored the node, he will also know the exact distance to the node.

sp-08440.description_en: Caster is aware of the specific triggers for any Node Ward spells currently active any node within range.

sp-08442.description_en: As Node Summons V above, but the total of levels is fifteen.

sp-08443.description_en: When the target's soul leaves its body, it will be interred into the node (the node may be any node "stored" by the caster) and will stay in the node for the duration of this spell. The interred soul will enter any "soulless" body brought into the node.

sp-08444.description_en: One sentient target becomes a "defender" for the specified node. Both the caster and the target must occupy the node at the time of caster. While acting as a defender, the target will make all RRs at the caster's level instead of his own. In addition, he will have+ 10 to all of his OBs, DB, and all maneuvers. For the duration of this spell, the target cannot leave the radius of the node.

sp-08445.description_en: As Node Ward: Alarm, exceptthe 'enemy' must make an RR (modified by -20) or flee in terror.

sp-08447.description_en: As Node Summons V, except twenty levels of animals are summoned.

sp-08448.description_en: Casteropens a 5' x 1O' doorway connecting two nodes. The nodes must be within 100 miles per level of the caster and both must be "stored" by the caster (with the Store Node spell). The doorway is two-way and anyone may pass through (so long as they can fit through the door). When the caster ceases to concentrate, the doorway will close. Any being caught in the gate when it closes takes an 'E' slash critical (see Anns Law) and is randomly sent to one end of the gate (flip a coin). Any severed limbs are automatically on the other side of the gate. Node gates must be formed as close to the center of a node as possible.

sp-08449.description_en: This spell prevents a node from moving. This spell ties the node to a "permanent" feature within the radius of the node. Permanent features include very large rocks, trees, etc. If the feature is moved, or if the feature is destroyed, this spell is cancelled.

sp-08450.description_en: As Node Defender, except so long as the target of this spell is within the node, he will not age and will recover(slowly) from any injury (the rule of thumb for recovery time for injuries is 1 day per 1 hit or I% penalty; severed or destroyed limbs and organs take longer). If the Guardian leaves the node, the spell is cancelled.

sp-08451.description_en: The caster takes all of the power of a node and converts it into a single, on-going spell effect. The effect is limited by the power of the node (minor nodes can only create up to I 0th level effects, major nodes can create up to 20th level effects). While this effect is active, the node can do nothing else (including any normal abilities the node may have) and cannot be the target of any node spells (and any spells that were previously targetted on the node are temporarily suspended while this spell is active).

sp-08492.description_en: Caster "stores" his current location for use with later spells on this list. A given caster can only store one location for every five levels of experience (or portion thereof). For example, a third level caster can only have one location stored, while a thirteenth level caster can have three.

sp-08493.description_en: Caster teleports to a location up to 10' per level away. There can be no intervening "barriers" in a direct line between the caster and the point. A "barrier" is defined as anything the target could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-08494.description_en: Target object becomes intangible. This object cannot be handled in any fashion. In addition, it is only partially visible (detected with an Awareness maneuver modified by the -30).

sp-08495.description_en: I-As SelfLeaving, except not limited to the caster and the target can be teleported up to 200' away.

sp-08496.description_en: Caster causes his body (but not all of his gear and clothing) to become intangible and only partially visible (detected with an Awareness maneuver modified by 30). Movement is limited to a walking pace, but not limited to a horizontal plane (caster must simply concentrate to walk on a vertical plane). Caster passes through normal solid barriers and is unable to pick up objects. All maneuvers while intangible are modified by -50.

sp-08497.description_en: As Leaving II, except movement range is JO miles per level. This can be very risky depending upon the caster's famliarity with the destination locale. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen the place (but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or Jess) = 25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours)= 10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = I%; Lived in (for at least one year)= 0.01 %. In the case of failure, first determine the direction of the error (randomly). The amount of error is then determined by making a dlOO (openended) to determine the distance of error in feet. If the locale has been stored (with a Store Location spell), the chance of failure is halved (rounded up). I 0. Displacement I - Caster appears to be offset from where he really is. All attacks have no effect I 0% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance of "no effect" for that foe goes down by 5%.

sp-08499.description_en: Caster may safely teleport to any location he has "stored" (with a Store Location spell). The stored location must be no more than I mile away.

sp-08500.description_en: As Leaving II, except target may move up to 500' away.

sp-08501.description_en: As Teleport I, except up to 5 targets may be moved.

sp-08502.description_en: As Returning I, except location can be up to 5 miles away.

sp-08503.description_en: As Displacement I, except attacks have no effect 20% of the time.

sp-08504.description_en: As Returning I, except location can be up to 10 miles away.

sp-08505.description_en: As Leaving II, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level. I 8. Lord Returning-As Returning/, except location can be up to 20 miles away.

sp-08507.description_en: As Leaving II, except target may move up to 1,000' away.

sp-08508.description_en: As Displacement I, except attacks have no effect 30% of the time and the spell is not limited to only the caster.

sp-08509.description_en: As Teleport I, except affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-08510.description_en: As Returning /, except caster may return to a stored location (must be within JO miles per level of the caster away), stay up to I round per level of the caster, and then return to the location where he cast this spell (thus making it a round trip).

sp-08511.description_en: Caster may project an image of himself a distance ofup to I mile per level away. Ifhe so desires, he may concentrate to make this image tangible (but the image is limited to 50%activity while tangible). The image can perform any functions thatthe caster could normally perform. While this spell is active, the caster may not perform any other actions (except to make his image perform actions).

sp-07388.description_en: Caster gains insight into target item's inherent power. If the item has PPs or charges, he will know exactly how many.

sp-07389.description_en: Caster bathes the area in magical energy, creating waves of magical resonance. All spells become visible (if the GM deems it appropriate, all Power Perception maneuvers are modified by +50 instead of all spells becoming visible).

sp-07390.description_en: Creates a wall of pure magical power(this wall is visible as a rippling wall of light). All coming into contact with the wall suffer a 'A' Mana critical. No spells can be cast through this wall (and no power can be detected through the wall).

sp-07391.description_en: I - Caster fires a blinding white beam of concentrated power from his palm. Bolt strikes on the Mana Bolt Attack Table. Mana Bolts add + 10 to all Spell Risk Rolls.

sp-07392.description_en: As Magelight I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07393.description_en: Caster imbues a mundane (non-magical) weapon with raw power. Strikes made with the weapon yield Mana criticals of one less severity to the normal Anns Law criticals. In addition, directed elemental attacks may be parried with the Eldritch Weapon at half effectiveness (2 points of OB giving 1 point of DB). When this spell expires, the weapon is automatically consumed (destroyed beyond use).

sp-07394.description_en: I - Caster creates an explosion of pure magical power. Those caught within the area are subjected to an attack on the Mana Ball Attack Table. Mana Balls add +20 to all Spell Risk Rolls.

sp-07395.description_en: As Mana Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07396.description_en: Caster opens a channel between himself and the target. The target and the caster may freely exchange PPs. Note that neither the caster nor the target may exceed his normal maximum of PPs. When spell expires, the PPs remain exchanged.

sp-07397.description_en: As Mana Ball I, above, except for the area of effect.

sp-07398.description_en: As Eldritch Weapon, except weapon delivers Mana critical equal in severity to normal criticals.

sp-07399.description_en: As Mage light I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07400.description_en: As Mana Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07401.description_en: The target of this spell regains half of his currently spent PPs. If the target has not spent any PPs, this spell has no effect on him. For example, if the target normally have SO PPs and has spent 20, he would be returned to 40 PPs (regaining 10). If that same caster had spent all of his PPs, he would be returned to 25 PPs (regaining 25).

sp-07402.description_en: Caster summons a sentient portion of his power source. The animate mana remains so long as the caster concentrates. The animated mana fights as a Weak Fire Elemental (except dealing Mana crits instead of Heat crits). The mana creature is immune to non-magical weapons. Elemental spells heal the number of hits that they would have inflicted to the construct, with criticals being ignored. If the caster ceases to concentrate, the mana creature vanishes in a bright flash. SO. Mana Pool - All spell users within the area of effect may share power points freely amongst themselves. PPs are totaled each round and all spell users may access all PPs in the pool. No spell user suffers penalties for PP expenditure until the pool is sufficiently drained (at which time, all spell users suffer the same penalties). No caster can regain PPs while they are in the area of effect of this spell (and the pool does not regain PPs). If a caster leaves the area, he loses all his normal PPs (as they are in the pool), though they may be regained normally.

sp-07404.description_en: Caster becomes aware of the nature (good, evil, chaotic, orderly, etc.) and amount of power in a detected source. Caster also learns of the division of the species of the source.

sp-07405.description_en: Caster links himself to a source of power, replenishing his PPs. Caster absorbs one PP per minute.

sp-07406.description_en: This spell allows the target's maximum number of PPs per day (including multipliers, but excluding adders) to be increased by 10%. Every PP over the normal maximum left within the target when the spell ends inflicts d5 of damage. In addition, for every 5 PPs over the normal maximum, the target takes an 'A' Void critical. The target will continue to take the critical(s) until such a time as his current PPs is less than his normal maximum.

sp-07407.description_en: This spell allows the caster to send or receive PPs from the target of this spell. The maximum number of PPs that may be transferred is equal to 10% of the caster's normal maximum PPs. Both the caster and the target must concentrate for the transfer to take place. Either the target or the caster can cancel this spell at any time.

sp-07408.description_en: This spell allows the caster to recharge any item that normally contains charges (e.g., wands, staves, etc.). For each casting of this spell, once charge is placed into the item. Item's cannot have more charges than they are designed for.

sp-07409.description_en: As Tap Source I, except three points per minute may be absorbed. I 0. Increase Lilllit II- As Increase Limit I, except the increase is20% .

sp-07411.description_en: As Lesser Power Merge, except for the increased range and the maxi mum number of transferred PPs is 50% of the caster's normal maximum.

sp-07412.description_en: As Recharge Item I, except two charges per casting is placed into the item.

sp-07413.description_en: As Increase Limit I, except the increase is 30%.

sp-07414.description_en: As Tap Source I, except that the caster connects the target to the source. The caster does not have to concentrate, but the target must concentrate (or the spell is cancelled). After the spell is cast, the target may cancel it at any time.

sp-07415.description_en: As Tap Source I, except one PP per round is absorbed.

sp-07417.description_en: As Increase Limit I, except increase is 50%.

sp-07418.description_en: As Lesser Power Merge, except for the increased range and the maximum number of transferred PPs is 90% of the caster's normal maximum.

sp-07419.description_en: As Recharge Item I, except five charges per casting is placed into the item.

sp-07420.description_en: As Increase Limit I, except increase is 100%.

sp-07421.description_en: As Tap Source I, except two PPs per round are absorbed.

sp-07423.description_en: Caster temporarily imbeds power into an item (which he may later tap as a source of power with a Tap Source spell). This item is known as a Store. The spell stores one PP per level of the caster into an item. The stored PPs must be expended at the time this spell is cast. Typically, the item must be specially constructed of crystalline stone. The stone must be at least one ouce (in weight) per PP to be stored. A given caster can only have one Store at a time.

sp-07424.description_en: [RR Mod: -30] When the caster concentrates he drains I PP per minute from the target. The target can be any target that has PPs (including anyone that currently has PPs). If the target fails his RR by more than 30, he does not even notice the effects of the spell. The spell is cancelled whenever the caster ceases to touch the target.

sp-07425.description_en: I-As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 3 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07426.description_en: As Power Storage/, except the Store is permanent (and can be recharged with Store spells). In addition, this spell can create a store out of any inorganic material (transforming the material into the proper crystalline structure). If a new Store is created by a given caster, any old stores are dispelled.

sp-07427.description_en: The caster charges a Store with 5 PPs per minute, as long as he concentrates. The PPs come from his personal reserve.

sp-07428.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 5 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07429.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Drain Power/, except that the caster may drain 3 PPs per minute.

sp-07430.description_en: As Create Store/, except the Store may hold up to 3 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07431.description_en: As Store V, except that up to 10 PPs per minute may be stored.

sp-07432.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 10 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07433.description_en: I- [RR Mod: -10] As Drain Power I, except that the caster may drain 1 PP per round.

sp-07434.description_en: As Create Store I, except Store may hold up to 5 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07435.description_en: As Store V, except that up to 20 PPs per minute may be stored.

sp-07436.description_en: As Drain Power I, except the caster may drain 2 PPs per round.

sp-07437.description_en: As Power Storage I, except that the Store may contain up to 20 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07438.description_en: As Store V, except that up 1 PP per level of the caster is transfered per minute.

sp-07439.description_en: As Create Store I, except the Store may hold up to 20 PPs per level of the caster.

sp-07441.description_en: I-Any spell(s) cast will affect twice as many targets as normal. This only affects spells that have specific targets for the spell (e.g., a Detect Essence spell would be unaffected, but Healing I would allow the caster to heal two people).

sp-07442.description_en: As Spell mastery I, except that the bonus is +20.

sp-07443.description_en: Spells with a range of 'self may be cast at a range of 'touch.'

sp-07444.description_en: Any spells castthat do not have a range of 'self are fired as a Directed Elemental Attack with a range of 100'. The caster may even develop Directed Spell skill with any spells (if he has developed this spell). Instead of making a normal BAR, he rolls dlOO (open-ended) and adds his Directed Spell skill plus 10.(target may subtract his normal DB) He looks up the result on the Basic Spell Attack Table to determine the victim's RR modification.

sp-07445.description_en: Any spell(s) cast will have twice the normal area of effect. This only affects spells that have a radius for area of effect (e.g., a Detect Essence spell would have a lO'R, but Healing I would be unaffected).

sp-07446.description_en: Spells with a range of 'touch' now have a range of 10'.

sp-07447.description_en: As Spell Mastery I, except that the bonus is +30. I 0. Ball Form I - Any spells cast that do not have a range of 'self are fired as a Ball Elemental Attack with a range of 100' and a radius of 10'. Instead of making a normal BAR, he rolls d!OO (open-ended) and adds 10. He looks up the result on the Basic Spell Attack Table to determine the victims' RR modification. In addition, any target at the center of the radius suffers an additional RR modification of -35.

sp-07449.description_en: Any spells castthat do not have a range of 'self may be formed into a wall of the dimensions I 0' x I 0' x 1" and the spell will have a duration of 1 minute per level of the caster. The wall is visible as a churning mass of magical energy. Anyone (or thing) contacting the wall will be affected by the spell (with no RR).

sp-07450.description_en: As Range II, except a spell with a range of 10' or more has 50' added to the range.

sp-07451.description_en: As Bolt Form I, except the range is 200'.

sp-07452.description_en: Any spells cast that do not have a range of 'self may be formed into a cloud (with a radius of l' per level of the spell) and the spell will have a duration of 1 minute per level of the caster. The cloud is visible as a shimmering cloud of mystical vapors. Anyone (or thing) contacting the cloud will be affected by the spell (with no RR) .

sp-07453.description_en: As Ball Form I, except that the radius is 20' .

sp-07454.description_en: As Wall Form, exceptthat the wall is a circle with the dimensions of 10'R x 10' x l ".

sp-07455.description_en: As Wall Form, except that the wall has the dimensions of 10' x 20' x I"

sp-07456.description_en: The caster may change the type of any spell he casts to any other type of spell (except for type I). For example, he can make a Force spell (type F), into a Passive spell (type P). The caster cannot add or subract the sub-types of spells (subconscious or mental). Note that changing the spell type simply changes the way RRs are made (and which column of the Spell Failure Table is used); it does not change the nature of the spell- a Sleep spell changed to an Elemental type would mean that the targets do not get an RR.

sp-07457.description_en: As Circle Form I, except that the circle is 30'R.

sp-07458.description_en: Any spells cast that do not have a range of 'self may be fonned into a storm (with a radius of 10' per level of the spell) and the spell will have a duration of 1 minute per level of the caster. Suitable targets must make an RR each round they are in the radius of the storm, or be affected by the spell.

sp-07460.description_en: Target's power and the power of any items on his person are obscured to viewers. The target may make an RR to obscure any detection or discerning spells (and any Power Perception maneuver used on him or his items suffers a -75 penalty).

sp-07462.description_en: Magic is drawn from the air in a channel extending from the caster's hand, forming a pitch black beam. The bolt strikes on the Void Bolt Attack Table. Void Bolts are very difficult to detect and therefore all Spell Risk rolls concerning it are at -20.

sp-07463.description_en: As Hide Power I, except for the duration.

sp-07464.description_en: As Magedark I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07465.description_en: As Void Bolt I, except for the range. JO. Void Ball - Caster draws all magical energy out of a JO' radius sphere. The attack is resolved on the Void Ball Attack Table. Void Balls are very difficult to detect and therefore all Spell Risk rolls concerning it are at -20.

sp-07467.description_en: Target loses all power points in a flash of darkness. Shortage lasts for one day.

sp-07468.description_en: As Void Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07469.description_en: As Magedark I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07470.description_en: As Void Ball/, above, except for the area of effect.

sp-07471.description_en: As Unpower, except shortage lasts for one day plus one day per I 0% failure. I 8. Void Bolt V - As Void Bolt I, except for the range.

sp-07477.description_en: Detects any active ward; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-07478.description_en: Caster gains understanding the nature of the target ward (including all things prohibited/protected by the ward).

sp-07479.description_en: The area of the spell is protected from intrusion by any normal creatures. Any creature above level 0 must make an RR (versus the level fo the caster) or they will not be able to enter the protected area.

sp-07482.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to two different spells.

sp-07484.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to three different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07485.description_en: As Alarm Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07486.description_en: As Protected Site, except for the area of effect.

sp-07487.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to four different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07488.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that caster may prevent up to five different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07489.description_en: As Scrying Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07490.description_en: As Spell Ward I, except that caster may prevent up to seven different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07491.description_en: As A farm Ward I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07492.description_en: As Repulsion Ward, except that caster may also specify a single sentient race that will receive an additional penalty of 20 to their RR (when they attempt to enter the protected area).

sp-07493.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that caster may prevent up to ten different spells (and all versions of those spells).

sp-07494.description_en: As Spell Ward/, except that all forms of magical transportation (leaping, leaving, long door, teleportation, returning, etc.) are prevented. Casters/beings attempting to enter or leave must make an RR (with a special -30 modifier) versus the level of the caster to actually enter or leave via magical methods.

sp-07496.description_en: The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects in the area. Caster may concentrate on a different IO'R area each round.

sp-07497.description_en: When concentrating, the target gains the ability to see through plants as if they were nonexistent.

sp-07498.description_en: The caster creates a field of energy around the target. All spells cast will require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver. If the spell is a Channeling spell, there is an additional -10 penalty to the maneuver.

sp-07499.description_en: The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration.

sp-07500.description_en: The target suffers a 'B' Void critical each time he casts a spell. If the target fails his RR by more than 20, he is unaware that this spell has been cast upon him. If the target is casting a Channeling spell, he takes a 'C' Void critical.

sp-07501.description_en: The target believes he has fallen into disfavor with his lord, church, religion, god, etc .. No therapy will help this. The target will take irrational actions to regain favor.

sp-07502.description_en: All tracks and traces of passing within the area are eradicated.

sp-07503.description_en: All plant material within the area turns into a grey mush and falls to the ground. The grey mush is still fertile, however.

sp-07504.description_en: Target is without power points. The duration of this spell is 1 hour for targets who do not have Channeling as their realm; one day for Channeling targets.

sp-07505.description_en: Target is cured of one diagnosed or known disease (the caster must know the specific disease or this spell has no effect).

sp-07506.description_en: As Defoliation I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07507.description_en: One known curse is removed from target (the caster must know the specific curse or this spell has no effect).

sp-07508.description_en: All animals (of animal intelligence or lower) must make a RR or they will not enter area. Animals within the area when the spell is cast must make an RR each round or leave the area. Animal that are magically controlled receive a special +10 modifier to their RRs.

sp-07509.description_en: As Soul Poison I, except for the duration.

sp-07510.description_en: As Defoliation I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07511.description_en: Creates a false trail (length of I mile per level of the caster). A successful Read Tracks maneuver (with a -70 modfier) will reveal that the trail is false.

sp-07512.description_en: Target is unable to magical means of transportaion for the duration.

sp-07513.description_en: Target is plagued by extreme doubt of his faith. He will cease any combat immediately. A pilgrimage is sure to follow.

sp-07514.description_en: Caster may use the other spells on this list once per round.

sp-07516.description_en: One musical intrument becomes completely out of tune (-50 to all Play ... maneuvers). This spell can also be cast on a person's voice (with a duration of! round per 10% failure).

sp-07517.description_en: The target may see all persons rendered invisible.

sp-07518.description_en: The caster creates a field of energy around the target. All spells cast will require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver. If the spell cast is a Mentalism spell, there is an additioanl -10 penalty to this maneuver.

sp-07519.description_en: The target suffers a 'B' Void critical each time he casts a spell. If the caster fails his RR by more than 20, he is unaware that this spell has been cast upon him. If the target is casting a Mentalism spell, he takes a 'C' Void critical.

sp-07520.description_en: Target loses one magically stored bit of information. This can be any information that was stored with a Store ... spell (or any other similar spell).

sp-07521.description_en: Target suffers a -50 to all activities.

sp-07522.description_en: Target's disguise falls apart. This spell will even dispel a magical guise.

sp-07523.description_en: Target is without power points. The duration of this spell is l hour for targets who do not have Mentalism as their realm; one day for Mentalism targets.

sp-07524.description_en: As Mind Poison I, except for the duration.

sp-07525.description_en: Target is cured of any mental illnesses.

sp-07526.description_en: Target person is no longer attuned to one of his magic items. The caster must be touching either the magic item or the target person. If the caster is touching the target person and the target magic item, he receives a special modifier of -20 to his RR. If the caster is only touching the target person, one of the target's item at random is no longer attuned to the target person.

sp-07528.description_en: Caster may accurately discern the nature of any one target (ignoring all magical guises).

sp-07529.description_en: As Mind Poison I, except for the duration, and the target is subjected to 'D' severity criticals ('E' for Mentalism targets).

sp-07530.description_en: When the caster is attacked by any mental spell (a spell sub-type of "m"), the offender is drawn into the caster's mind and held for a while. The offender makes an RR (versus the level of the caster). He will be held for I hour per 10 failure (success indicates that offender avoids the trap). If drawn into the trap, the offender's body slumps lifelessly to the floor.
