sp-07531.description_en: The caster may use each of the 25th and lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-07532.description_en: When the target of this spell is the target of a spell, the "incoming" spell must first make an RR. For RR purposes, the incoming spell uses its caster's level. If the incoming spell fails the RR, it has no effect on the target.

sp-07533.description_en: If the target attempts to cast a spell while this spell is active, that spell (and only that first spell) automatically takes one extra round before the effects are resolved. This has no effect on the preparation/casting time-the effect is simply delayed one round.

sp-07534.description_en: Any active spell within the area of effect must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as its level). If the RR fails, the spell is dispelled.

sp-07535.description_en: If the target attempts to cast a spell while this spell is active, that spell (and only that first spell) automatically makes a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a -15 penalty.

sp-07536.description_en: The target's must make a Spell Casting Static Maneuever (ifhe is not already forced to make one) and rounds of preparation currently accrued are lost. This spell automatically stops a caster from concentrating on a spell that has a duration requiring concentration.

sp-07537.description_en: As Delay Spell I, except the effects are delayed for two rounds.

sp-07538.description_en: As Fumble/, except that the penalty is -30.

sp-07539.description_en: The caster's next spell has no perceptible effect (to normal senses or magical detections). Indirect effects will still be noticed. For example, if cast before a Fireball, the explosion is silent, invisible and will not be felt; but suddenly the vegetation will be burning and lots of damage will appear on the area.

sp-07540.description_en: The target forgets the spell that he most recently cast. He may not cast that spell again for the duration of this spell. All lower- and higher-level versions of the spell are also forgotten (e.g., Sleep V, Sleep X, etc.).

sp-07541.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target must make Spell Casting Static Maneuevers for all spells he wants to cast; each of these maneuvers suffers a -10 penalty.

sp-07542.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any information gathering spells cast on anything in the area will only discern what the caster specifies. The caster must specify exactly what will be learned (if left unspecific, the information spell will discern the truth). For example, if the caster specifies that his presence in the area will be masked, all information spells will reveal everything as normal, except the caster of this spell will not be revealed.

sp-07543.description_en: As Delay Spell I, excpet the effects are delayed for three rounds.

sp-07544.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -30.

sp-07545.description_en: As Dispel Magic I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07546.description_en: The caster may change the target spell into any spell of the same Type of lower level. The caster of the targetted spell is fully aware of the change and has full control over the spell (for durations, targets, etc.).

sp-07547.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -40.

sp-07548.description_en: Target magic item loses all magical abilities. Artifacts receive a special +30 bonus to their RR. All items use creator's level for item level in RR and add their inherent bonuses to the roll.

sp-07549.description_en: As Dispel Magic I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07550.description_en: As Disjunction, except that artifacts do not get the special bonus to their RR. Some very powerful items may still receive this bonus (GM's discretion).

sp-07551.description_en: As Failure I, except that the penalty is -50.

sp-07552.description_en: Caster may use the other spells on this list, once per round .

sp-07553.description_en: Caster may cast this spell with any spell he wants to store. The spell to be stored must be caster within one minute after the Spell Store spell is cast. The stored spell may then be caster later as an instantaneous spell. The Spell Store spell costs the same number of PPs as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-07554.description_en: This spell may be cast while a spell is stored (with Spell Store). After casting this spell, the caster may cast one other spell normally (even if he has one spell stored). If the caster has more than one spell stored, this spell has no effect.

sp-07555.description_en: As Store Spell I, except the stored spell may come from another spell user. The caster of the spell that is stored must expend the PPs normally required, and the caster of the Store Other's Spell must expend an equal number of PPs plus the PPs for casting this spell. Both casters must be touching each other. When the stored spell is cast, treat as though the caster of the Store Other's Spell cast the spell (for level, duration, etc.).

sp-07556.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] The target spell is reversed back upon its caster. If necessary, the spell is treated as having a +O attack mofication.

sp-07557.description_en: After casting this spell, the caster may combine the effects of any two non-elemental spells (i.e., DE, BE, or E type spells). The two spells to be combined must be cast within two minutes of the completion of this spell (and PPs must be expended normally for those spells); however, the effects from the spells are delayed until both spells are completed. The level of the complex spell is treated as the higherofthe two spell levels plus 10.

sp-07558.description_en: This spell may be cast while another spell is stored. After storing a spell, the caster may store a second spell by casting this spell. Treat this spell in all ways as a Spell Store / (except one spell must already be stored before this spell has any effect). This spell may not be activated until after the first stored spell is activated. Once the first spell is activated, the 1.it11v i • I spell stored with Store Spell II, is treated in all ways as ifit were stored with a Spell Store I.

sp-07559.description_en: Caster may cast this spell with any spell that he wants to put a contingency upon. That spell will trigger anytime the specific condition is met. The condition must have something to do with the caster (e.g., the caster is falling, stunned, wet, etc.). This does not count as a stored spell (and other spells may be cast while this effect remains dormant. Only one contingency spell may be active on the caster at any given time. The caster must pay the PPs for both this spell and the spell that is put on contingency.

sp-07560.description_en: As Complex Spell II, except that the effects ofup to three spells may combined (and they must be cast within three minutes after completing this spell). The effective level for the new spell is the highest level of the three spells plus 15.

sp-07561.description_en: This spell affects the next Complex Spell cast (within one minute after completion of this spell). After completing the Complex Spell (which must follow after this spell), the combined spells may come from different spell users. All casters must be touching each other (and they must all be willing participants).

sp-07562.description_en: When this spell is cast, the caster may designate any one spell (up to 5th level in power) that will automatically be triggered when a specific condition is met (similar to Contingency); this spell will be triggered everytime the condition is met (as long as the caster has PP to available). The PPs for the activated spell are spent once when the Auto Response spell is cast, and then every time the spell is triggered. Triggering of an auto-response spell takes 0% activity, but cannot violate the restriction of one spell per round. A given caster may have only one auto response spell active at a time (if another Auto Response spell is cast, the previous one is cancelled).

sp-07563.description_en: As Store Spell I/, except that this spell cannot be cast until a second spell has been stored. After the first stored spell is cast, this spell becomes exactly like a spell stored with Store Spell I/.

sp-07564.description_en: As Bypass Stored Spell, except that caster may bypass any number of stored spells.

sp-07565.description_en: As Complex Spell I/, except four spell effects may be combined (and they must be cast within four minutes after completing this spell). The effective level for the new spell is the highest level of the three spells plus 20.

sp-07566.description_en: As Contingency and Complex Spell II combined.

sp-07567.description_en: As Auto Response V, except that up to 10th level spells may be used.

sp-07568.description_en: The caster's next spell (must be cast within one minute after completing this spell) will last as long as the caster concentrates. The will not affect spells with a duration of"-."

sp-07569.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's range increased by 50'.

sp-07570.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's duration tripled.

sp-07572.description_en: As Extend Range /, except that range is increased by 100'.

sp-07573.description_en: Causes the next spell that the target casts (must be within I minute of the completion of this spell) to have it's radius increased by 5'.

sp-07574.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is quadrupled (x4).

sp-07576.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by 300'.

sp-07577.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except Radius is increased by 10'.

sp-07579.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by 500'.

sp-07580.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except radius is increased by 15'.

sp-07581.description_en: As Extend Duration lll, except that duration is increased by ten times.

sp-07582.description_en: As Extend Range/, except that range is increased by 1,000' .

sp-07583.description_en: As Extend Range IV, except that this spell is instantaneous.

sp-07584.description_en: As Increase Radius/, except radius is increased by 20'.

sp-07585.description_en: As Increase Radius I, except radius is increased by 25'.

sp-07586.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is increased by 20 times.

sp-07587.description_en: As Extend Range I, except that range is increased by I 00' per level of the caster.

sp-07588.description_en: As Extend Duration Ill, except that duration is Permanent.

sp-07589.description_en: Everyone with 5' of the caster adds +5 to all their RRs.

sp-07590.description_en: Caster gains + 10 to RRs versus a specific element (chosen at time of casting) and 10 is subtracted from any elemental attack from that element (when the caster is the target of the attack).

sp-07591.description_en: As Protect I, except bonus is + 10.

sp-07593.description_en: As Resist Elements, except RR bonus is +20 and elemental attacks suffer a -20 penalty.

sp-07594.description_en: As Spell Shield I, except that two realms may be chosen.

sp-07595.description_en: As Protect/, except for the area of effect.

sp-07597.description_en: Caster gains protection from a specific realm of magic (chosen at the time of casting). All RRs versus spells of that realm are receive a bonus of +30.

sp-07598.description_en: I - As Element Shield /, except that all criticals are reduced by one severity ("D" becomes "C", "B" becomes "A", "A" subtracts 50 from the critical result, etc.) and all concussion damage is halved.

sp-07599.description_en: As Protect//, except for the area of effect.

sp-07601.description_en: As Realm Annor I, except that two realms may be chosen.

sp-07602.description_en: I As Element Annor I, except that two elements may be protected against. I 9. Protect Sphere III As Protect l/l, except for the area of effect.

sp-07604.description_en: As Spell Shield /, except that caster may shield up tp 1 target for each of his level.

sp-07605.description_en: As Realm Armor I, except that caster may protect up tp I target for each of his level.

sp-07606.description_en: As Realm Annor /, except that Bonus is +50.

sp-07607.description_en: As Realm Resistance // and Element Armor // simultaneously.

sp-07735.description_en: Allows the target to leap 50' laterally or 20' horizontally in the round that this spell is cast.

sp-07736.description_en: Allows the target to land safely after a fall up to 20' per level of the caster. The target may also take that distance off of the severity of a greater fall.

sp-07737.description_en: Caster teleports the target to a point up to 100' away. There can be no intervening "barriers" in a direct line between the target and the point. A "barrier" is defined as anything the target could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-07738.description_en: Target can fly at a rate of75' per round (approximately 5 mph). While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g., walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.

sp-07739.description_en: The caster stores a location for use with other spells (e.g., Teleport and Returning spells). When used with a Teleport spell, the location is treated as "Studied carefully." The caster can have only one location stored at a time.

sp-07740.description_en: Target can walk on water as if he were on level ground; may not be used on rough water.

sp-07741.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 150' per round.

sp-07742.description_en: As Leaving I, except target can pass through barriers by specifying exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the target does not move; instead, he is stunned dlO rounds (the caster still expends the PPs for this spell).

sp-07743.description_en: As Long Door I, except movement range is I 0 miles per level. This can be very risky depending upon the caster's famliarity with the destination's locale. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen the place (but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or less) = 25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours)= 10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = 1%;Livedin(foratleastayear) =0.01 %. In the case of failure, first determine the direction of the error (randomly). The amount of the error is then determined by making ad 100 (openended) to determine the distance in feet.

sp-07744.description_en: Target's feet (and footwear, while he is wearing them) grip to any surface (walls, ceilings, branches, etc.). The target gains a +50 on any maneuvers involving balance while using this spell. The target may move at a Walking pace or slower.

sp-07745.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 300' per round.

sp-07746.description_en: Target may merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, the target cannot move or perceive. When the target emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The target cannot move "through" material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can exit at any time up to 1 hournevel; all other targets must emerge after a specified time (the caster specifies the time when the spell is cast, must be less than 1 hour per level).

sp-07747.description_en: As Gripping I, except target may move up to a Run (x2) pace.

sp-07748.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 450' per round.

sp-07749.description_en: As Leaving I, except range of the teleport is up to one mile.

sp-07750.description_en: As Teleport I, except that the caster may teleport up to five targets.

sp-07751.description_en: Caster is immediately returned to his stored location (see Store Location) if that stored location is less than 10 miles per level of the caster away.

sp-07752.description_en: As Gripping I, except the target may move at up to a Sprint pace (x3).

sp-07753.description_en: As Fly I, except affects a number of targets equaling the caster's level.

sp-07754.description_en: As Teleport I, except that caster may teleport a number of targets equaling his level.

sp-07755.description_en: As Gripping I, except the target may m o v e ' at up to a Fast Sprint pace (x4).

sp-07756.description_en: As Teleport I, except the range ot the teleport is unlimited.

sp-07764.description_en: This spell overloads the target's senses. If the RR fails by 50 or less, the target is stunned for the duration. If theRR fails by more than 50, he is unconscious. l 0. Circular Vision - Caster may see in all directions simultaneously. No attacks against the caster may have the flank orrear bonuses.

sp-07766.description_en: As Long Sense I, except that the caster may employ up to two senses simultaneously.

sp-07767.description_en: As Sense Loss /, except that the caster may designate up to two senses.

sp-07768.description_en: As Nightvision, except no light is required and the caster can see even in magically created darkness.

sp-07769.description_en: As Sense Loss/, except for the number of targets.

sp-07770.description_en: As Enhance Sense/, except that the caster may enhance three senses.

sp-07771.description_en: As Sense Loss/, except for the duration.

sp-07772.description_en: As Sense Loss/, except that the caster may designate up to three senses.

sp-07773.description_en: As Torment, except duration is permanent (until healed) and the target takes I 00% of his remaining hits.

sp-07774.description_en: Total sensory deprivation, i.e., no sensory input. Every day of deprivation gives a 5% chance (cumulative) of temporary insanity.

sp-07775.description_en: Target experiences a totally: different reality. Everything in the real world has an analog in the hallucination. The caster has no control over exactly what the target experiences.

sp-07776.description_en: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list, one per round.

sp-07757.description_en: Random limb of target's is numb and useless. If the limb is a leg, the target loses 40% of his movement. If the limb is an arm, the target suffers -40 to melee and missile fire with that arm.

sp-07758.description_en: Caster enhances one of his senses (sight, hearing, etc.). Caster gains a +30 to Awareness maneuvers with this sense.

sp-07759.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some small amount of residual light is required for this spell to work. See Sectio 7. I.I 9 (in Spell Law) for more on the environment's effect on vision.

sp-07760.description_en: Target feels pain, and he takes 60% of his remaining hits.

sp-07761.description_en: Target loses use of one sense (of caster's choice) for the duration. All attempts to use that sense suffer a -100 penalty.

sp-07762.description_en: Caster may cast a single sense (sight, hearing, etc.) to be used at a point up to I 00' distant (ignoring intervening barriers). Once placed the point may not move, but may rotate.

sp-07763.description_en: As Enhance Sense I, except that the caster may enhance two senses.

sp-07779.description_en: Caster can alter his form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form cannot be a specific form. For example, a human caster could take on the form of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., the target who becomes a Dwarf would not recieve the Dwarves' ability to see in the dark). The caster can only alter his size by up to 25%. See Section 7.1.11 (in Spell Law).

sp-07780.description_en: A single piece of wood, ofup to JO cubic feet in volume, becomes as hard as granite.

sp-07781.description_en: One item (up to 5 cubic feet) becomes as brittle as thin glass. Treat as an item that must always check for breakage with a Strength factor of equal to a dJO.

sp-07782.description_en: As Reinforce Wood, except that a single stone (up to 10 cubic feet) becomes as hard as steel.

sp-07783.description_en: Caster may increase his mass by up to JO% per level of the caster (height in most situations); there is no increase in his strength (except for movement purposes). JO. Unbreakable-Oneobjectofno greater volume than I cubic foot is made unbreakable. Treat as having a Strength of 250.

sp-07785.description_en: As Change to Kind, except that the caster may change his form at will, by concentrating for one round per change.

sp-07786.description_en: As Reinforce Wood, except that a single iron or steel object (up to JO cubic feet) becomes unbreakable.

sp-07787.description_en: Caster creates a tunnel 6' radius by 10' long through any non-living, organic or inorganic mass.

sp-07788.description_en: As Enlarge, except that the mass change is 20% per level of the caster.

sp-07789.description_en: Caster causes up to I cubic foot per level of any nonmagical, non-living solid to melt. There is no increase in temperature, so the material will begin to solidify immediately after the duration of this spell expires. The melting takes 3 rounds.

sp-07791.description_en: Caster causes up to I cubic foot per level ofany normal liquid to boil. Liquid will continue to boil as long as the caster concentrates. The caster must be able to see the target liquid. Boiling takes 3 rounds. Caster is immune to damage from the boiling liquid.

sp-07793.description_en: As Impersonate, except that any mass may be gained up to 100% per level.

sp-07794.description_en: As Enlarge, except for the number of targets.

sp-07795.description_en: May transmute up to I ounce of any nonmagical substance to any other non-magical substance. This takes 8 hours of uninterrupted concentration.

sp-07797.description_en: Creates dense fog within the area.

sp-07798.description_en: The caster's hands become as hard as stone. Any attacks are made with Martial Arts 0B (using the most appropriate skill), but is resolved on the Mace Attack Table (see Arms law).

sp-07799.description_en: s - Caster creates an intense, directed updraft of air that can support a weight of up to 500 lbs. (so long as the weight is concentrated in the area of effect). The combination of height lifted times weight is always equal to 500. For example, a 100 pound man would be lifted 5 feet into the air; while a 500 pound object would be lifted I foot into the air; while a 2 pound object would be lifted 250 feet into the air.

sp-07800.description_en: Caster creates a wall of swirling hail I O' x I O' x 5' (deep). All coming into contact with the wall suffer a 'B' Impact critical. All movement through the wall is slowed by 75%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-07801.description_en: The caster raises one buried object from a depth

sp-07803.description_en: Target inorganic item (up to I cubic foot) is explodes into tiny fragments. All within 5'R take an 'A' Impact critical, the holder of the item takes a 'C' Impact critical. Metal objects get a special +30 modification to their RR.

sp-07804.description_en: Water quickly condenses around the target, causing him to begin drowning (as the air he breathes is mostly water now).

sp-07805.description_en: Disintegrates up to I 00 cubic feet of stone.

sp-07806.description_en: As Unstone, except that 10,000 cubic feet of water is destroyed.

sp-07807.description_en: Creates a great crack in the earth, measuring I 00 feet long, 50 feet deep and 30 feet wide.

sp-07808.description_en: Caster creates a Tornado. The tornado is not under the control of the caster.

sp-07809.description_en: All flammable material within the area is set ablaze. Fire will spread as normal.

sp-07810.description_en: Causes a very minor earthquake which could cause shoddy construction to collapse (this can be very terrifying). This is approximately 5.5 on the Richter scale.

sp-07811.description_en: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-07813.description_en: Caster adds 5 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-07814.description_en: II - Caster reads at a rate of 20 pages per minute.

sp-07815.description_en: Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity). See Section 7.1.24 in Spell Law for more information.

sp-07816.description_en: For the duration of this spell, any wounds that deliver stun effects to the caster have the number of rounds of stun reduced by one.

sp-07817.description_en: Casterreceives a special+ 15 bonus to his next static maneuver (the static maneuver must be completed before the duration of this spell expires).

sp-07818.description_en: In melee, the caster does double normal concussion hits and his Strength stat bonus is doubled.

sp-07819.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07820.description_en: Caster adds 10 to his next initiative roll next round.

sp-07821.description_en: As Focus/, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07822.description_en: For the duration of this spell, all criticals against the caster are reduced by one in severity (e.g., "E" becomes a "D", "B" becomes an "A", with an "A" receiving a -50 modification).

sp-07823.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07824.description_en: As Focus I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07825.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a bonus of +50 to any RRs versus disease and poison.

sp-07826.description_en: As Haste I, except for the duration.

sp-07827.description_en: Caster is able to sustain and additional I 00% of his total concussion hits before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-07828.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin toughens, giving him an effective AT of 11.

sp-07829.description_en: As Focus I, except the bonus is +60.

sp-07830.description_en: Caster receives the bonuses of Toughness I, Toughness II, Toughness Ill, and Unpain simultaneously .

sp-07831.description_en: Caster gains insight into the best way to hold a particular spell user so as to most impair his spell casting. If the caster follows this spell' s advice to the letter (which may take some time), every spell casting attempt will require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a special modifier of -50.

sp-07832.description_en: One of target's limbs (chosen randomly) is impaired and useless.

sp-07833.description_en: Target may not make any sounds.

sp-07834.description_en: Target is wrapped in magical bonds. If the target struggles, he suffers a 'B' Electricity.

sp-07835.description_en: Target humanoid is reduced to 25% activity.

sp-07836.description_en: Caster converts a room into a cell for holding spell users. The room can only contain one spell user (more than that dispels this spell). While in the cell, all spell casting attempts require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a special -100 modifier.

sp-07837.description_en: As Binds I, except for the duration.

sp-07838.description_en: As Hold Kind, except that any being may be held.

sp-07839.description_en: Target loses all PPs for the duration. The caster must know the target's realm of power, and the target must be from a single realm (i.e., not a hybrid spell user).

sp-07840.description_en: As Binds/, except for the duration.

sp-07841.description_en: As Create Cell, except room may holy 1 spell user for every I Osquare feet in the room. In addition, spell users will suffer a "D" Void critical when· they enter the room.

sp-07842.description_en: As Hold Kind, except for the duration.

sp-07843.description_en: As Remove Power I, except that any hybrid spell user may be targetted.

sp-07844.description_en: As Hold Kind, except for the number of targets.

sp-07845.description_en: As Remove Power I, except for the duration.

sp-07846.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question truthfully (presuming the target can understand the question).

sp-07847.description_en: Caster knows whether the target is lying or not.

sp-07848.description_en: Target humanoid believes that the caster is a good friend.

sp-07849.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 5 single concept questions.

sp-07850.description_en: Target will follow a single suggestion so long as it is not completely alien to him (no jumping off the bridge suggestions, no throwing yourself in front of runaway manure cart suggestions, etc).

sp-07851.description_en: The next spell the target attempts to cast requires a Spell Casting Static Maneuver (with a special -JO modifier).

sp-07852.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 10 single concept questions.

sp-07853.description_en: As Suggestion, except that two targets will receive the same suggestion. JO. Telepathy - Caster can read the surface thoughts of one target.

sp-07855.description_en: Target humanoid must obey caster. Commands must not be completely alien to the target.

sp-07856.description_en: As Question, except that target must respond to up to 20 single concept questions.

sp-07857.description_en: As Fumble Spell I, except affects the next three spells the target attempts to cast.

sp-07858.description_en: As Telepathy, except for the range.

sp-07859.description_en: The target forgets the spell that he most recently cast. He may not cast that spell again for the duration of this spell. All lower- and higher-level versions of the spell are also forgotten (e.g., Sleep V, Sleep X, etc.).

sp-07860.description_en: Caster may read target's conscious memories, at a rate of I scene per round.

sp-07862.description_en: Caster may read target's deep subconscious memories, at a rate of I scene per round.

sp-07863.description_en: As Mind Scan, except that the caster may scan a different target each round.

sp-07864.description_en: Caster may read a single memory from target's mind each round.

sp-07865.description_en: As Mind Probe, except that the caster may scan a different target each round. In addition, the number of scenes scanned per round is equal to the caster's level.

sp-07866.description_en: Caster memorizes the "signature" of a given spell user (the target of this spell). The caster can only have one signature memorized at a time. Any time this spell is cast, any previously memorized signatures are lost

sp-07867.description_en: This spell must be cast upon an active spell. The caster will immediately know if the spell was cast by the spell user with his currently memorized signature (see Spell Signature). The caster will also know if he has ever memorized the signature of the caster of the spell (though he does not know exactly which signature it is).

sp-07868.description_en: Caster learns whether or not there are any active spells in the area. The area of effect can be moved once per round (up to the range of the spell).

sp-07869.description_en: As Spell Detection, except that the caster learns of any spells that have ever been cast within the area. The caster only detects spells into the past one day per level of the caster.

sp-07870.description_en: Provides an analysis of an active spell; giving its duration, the list it was cast from, and its type (not its level or exactly what spell it is).

sp-07871.description_en: One random spell, cast in the area in the past (up to l hour per level of the caster), becomes an "active" spell for the duration of this spell. The spell is only treated as active for the purposes of other spells on this list (i.e., Spell Analysis may be cast upon it, etc.). If the caster has cast Detect Past Spell on this area, he may select one past spell to recall (rather than selecting an random one).

sp-07872.description_en: Caster learns the name (but not the version; e.g., Sleep, not Sleep X) of a single active spell.

sp-07873.description_en: Provides an analysis of an ability or power (active or not). One item, person, or place may be examined to see if it has power, which realm the power is from, a general idea of its origin, and its basic configuration.

sp-07874.description_en: Caster learns the purpose, origin, construction, and age of a single magical object.

sp-07875.description_en: As Spell Analysis, except that the spell need not be active any longer. Maximum time elapsed may only be I day per level of the caster. The spell must have been detected with Detect Past Spell.

sp-07876.description_en: Will detect the type (Force, Information, Passive, etc.) of all active spells in the area.

sp-07878.description_en: As Name Spell, except that the spell need not be active any longer. Maximum time elapsed may only be I hour per level of the caster. The spell must have been detected with Detect Past Spell.

sp-07879.description_en: Caster receives a vision of the target of a detected, past spell (e.g., a spell detected with Detect Past Spell).

sp-07880.description_en: As Power Analysis, except that caster also learns the origin, nature, and the exact amount of power in all objects and persons within the area.

sp-07881.description_en: Caster detects all spells that have ever been cast in the area (up to 1 day in the past per level of experience). The caster gets a vision of the spells, their targets, and their effects (though not necessarily the caster). This spell takes up to 30 minutes to cast (depending on how many spells were cast in the area).

sp-07882.description_en: Caster gains +5 to all RRs versus spells of all realms.

sp-07883.description_en: Caster is totally protected against all natural heat (up to 200°F and modifies spells involving heat by 10.

sp-07884.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against natural cold to -20°F and modifies spells involving cold by 10.

sp-07885.description_en: Caster gains + 10 on RRs and DB versus all frontal spell attacks. The caster must be aware of the attack(s) to get the bonus.

sp-07887.description_en: Casteris able to parry any directed spell attack. He may gain a bonus of+ 1 DB for every 5 points of OB put into the parry. In addition, the caster can parry any spell that he would normally get an RR against (so long as the origin of the spell is more than 5' away from the caster). In this case, he may gain an RR bonus of + 1 for every 5 points of OB put into the parry.

sp-07890.description_en: Caster gains +20 to RRs and DB versus electricity-based attacks.

sp-07891.description_en: As Light Shield, except applies to heat/firebased attacks.

sp-07892.description_en: As Light Shield, except applies to cold-based attacks.

sp-07893.description_en: As Spell Parry I, except that the bonus is gained for every 3 points of OB.

sp-07894.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] The target spell is reversed back upon its caster. If necessary, the spell is treated as having a +O attack modification.

sp-07895.description_en: As Spell Parry I, except that the bonus is gained for every point of OB.

sp-07896.description_en: As any one of Heat Shield, Light Shield, or Cold Shield (chosen at the time of casting). In addition, any damage incurred from the selected element is halved and all criticals taken from the element are reduced by one in severity ("D" goes to a "C", with an "A" critical modified by -50).

sp-07897.description_en: As Reverse Spells, except for the duration. Any spells that target the caster are reflected back upon their origin.

sp-07898.description_en: As all three variants of Elemental Shield (heat, cold, and light) simultaneous. In addition, the caster gains a +20 bonus to all RRs versus those elements.

sp-07900.description_en: Caster learns the direction and distance to the currently stored speUuser (i.e., whose signature has been stored with a Spell Signature spell, see the Power Lore spell list). The spell user must be within the area of effect.

sp-07901.description_en: All of the caster's Tracking maneuvers receive a bonus of +50.

sp-07902.description_en: Caster learns the direction and distance to any spell that he has currently stored the signal for. The spell must be active and must be in the area of effect.

sp-07903.description_en: As Sense I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07904.description_en: Caster may project his consciousness to follow the spell user that the caster currently has stored (i.e., whose signature has been stored with a Spell Signature spell, see the Power Lore spell list). The caster must know (exactly) the location of the target spell user. The caster's consciousness leaves his body and follows the target for the duration of this spell. While the consciousness is out of the caster's body, the caster feels nothing and is completely unaware of the environment surrounding the body. The consciousness can only see events around the target (no hearing).

sp-07905.description_en: As Location I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07906.description_en: Caster receives the direction and distance to the caster of any one currently stored spell (signal). The spell caster must currently be involved in spell casting or this spell will reveal nothing .

sp-07907.description_en: As Location/, except for the area of effect.

sp-07908.description_en: As Sense I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07909.description_en: As Shadow Mage II, except for the duration.

sp-07910.description_en: As Location I, except for the area of effect.

sp-07911.description_en: As Sense /, except for the area of effect.

sp-07912.description_en: The caster can cast any lower level spell on this list, once per round.

sp-07913.description_en: Caster determines the presence of any extradimensional entities within the area. A different area may be concentrated on each round. I 2. Origin of Entity - Caster learns the place of origin of the target entity and gets a vision of that place.

sp-07915.description_en: Allows the caster to totally control a Type I or Type II Entity (the chance of non-control is [the Entity's Type x 2%]). The Entity leaves when the caster stops concentrating. The Entity will not speak with the caster.

sp-07916.description_en: Caster summons a lesser Entity. Roll for random Type (01-55 Type I Entity; 56-90Type II Entity; 91-lOOType III Entity). The Entity forms over two rounds. Ifthe Entity is not mastered within 2 rounds, the caster suffers the effects as outline in Section 7 .1.31 of Spell law.

sp-07917.description_en: Caster enchants a Circle protecting him from Lesser Entities (no greater than Type II). Any Entity summoned from this list can be made to appear within or outside the Circle. Entities within the Circle may not leave the Circle while the caster is concentrating. Entities outside the Circle may not enter it while the caster is concentrating. Treat the edges of the Circle as a very specific Wall ofForce (creating an inpenatrable barrier between the caster and the Entity). The caster can cross the barrier freely (though why he would want to is not clear). The design of the Circle is very important and dictates the kind (race) of Entity is affected. Circles must be especially made for each race of Entity (demons, fire elementals, etc.) and will not affect any other kind of Entity. Only one Circle may be placed on each 40' x 40' area. The area must be flat and horizontal to the ground. Circles take some time to create (note that creating the Circle does not enchant it; this spell enchants an a Circle), depending upon the method of creation.

sp-07918.description_en: Caster may control any Type I Entity, regardless of its present state of control (mastered/controlled by another spell user, free, berserk, etc). The Entity will revert to its original state of control when the caster stops concentrating. If the Entity was being 'controlled' by another spellcaster and that caster is no longer concentrating, the original controller has three rounds to re-control the Entity or it will berserk. If the Entity was 'controlled' or 'mastered' by another spell user, the original controller may make an RR to prevent the seizure of control.

sp-07919.description_en: As Control Entity II, except that caster need not concentrate to control Entity. The chance of nonmastery is 5 times the Entity's type. The Entity will remain and obey the caster untilthe caster is killed or the Entity is outside the range limit or the caster releases him. A maximum of two Entities may be master at one time by one caster.

sp-07920.description_en: As Gate I, except that more powerful Entities may be summoned: 01-10 Type I; 11-20 Type II; 21-50 Type III; 51-90 Type IV; 91-100 Type V. JO. Seize Control II - As Seize Control I, except that the caster may seize control of a Type II Entity.

sp-07923.description_en: As Circle/, except that up to Type IV Entities are affected.

sp-07924.description_en: As Control Entity II, except that up to a Type IV Entity may be controlled.

sp-07925.description_en: As Seize Control/, except that the caster may seize control of a Type III Entity.

sp-07926.description_en: As Master Entity II, except that up to a Type IV Entity may be mastered.

sp-07927.description_en: As Circle I, except that up to a Type VI Entity are affected.

sp-07932.description_en: As Seize Mastery/, except that up to a Type V mastered Entity may be seized.

sp-07933.description_en: As Gate I, except that very powerful entities may be summoned: 01-03 Type I; 04-10 Type II; 11-20 Type III; 21-30 Type IV; 31-65 Type V; 66-90 Type IV; 91-100 Something bigger (a Elemental Lord or Demon Beyond the Pale, etc.; GM's discretion). Note that no method has yet been found to master Entities of Types greater than VI.

sp-07934.description_en: As Master Entity II, except that up to a Type VI Entity may be mastered.

sp-07954.description_en: As Leak Power I, except target loses 5 PPs per round.

sp-07955.description_en: Target loses a number of PPs equal to the caster's level.

sp-07957.description_en: Target rolls dlO0 (open-ended). Add the current number of corruption points the target has and subtract three times his SD bonus. If the result is over 100, the character has been converted to "evil." 1be GM should determine the ramifications of such an event.

sp-07958.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will cast one spell per round. The spell must be a Force, Directed Elemental, or Ball Elemental spell. The target will cast the highest level he can without giving himself more than a -5 Spell Casting Static Maneuver modification (after including all bonuses and penalties; including the fixed modification of +50). If the target cannot cast a spell every round without incurring too much penalty, the target will start casting one spell as often as he can. If the target cannot cast any Force, Directed Elemental, or Ball Elemental spells, this spell has no effect.

sp-07960.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will use spells for every possible application, rather than depend on skills or other characters. For example, he will cast Opening I instead of picking a lock.

sp-07961.description_en: The target power source (Earthnode, Ley-line, etc.) is temporarily corrupted. All power emanating from the source is condiered "evil" for the duration (with additional effects at the GM's discrection). Any power points drawn from this source will yield 10% of their number in corruption points. For example, if a spell user gains 10 PPs from a source, he will gain 1 corruption point.

sp-07962.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07963.description_en: As Magical Frenzy, except for the duration and target will attempt spells that do not incur a penalty ofless than -25.

sp-07964.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 5 corruption points.

sp-07965.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07966.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 7 corruption points.

sp-07967.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07968.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains 10 corruption points.

sp-07969.description_en: As Call of Darkness, except that yield is 20% (10 PPs = 2 corruption points).

sp-07970.description_en: As Corrupting Influence I, except for the duration.

sp-07971.description_en: As Seed of Corruption, except target gains a number of corruption points equal to the caster's level.

sp-07973.description_en: As Spook /, except for number of targets.

sp-07974.description_en: Target must make a Fear RR.

sp-07975.description_en: As Spook/, except for number of targets.

sp-07976.description_en: Creates a 'Cold Spot,' a region of uneasiness and mild fear. Anyone entering the area must make a Fear RR (with a + I O modifier).

sp-07977.description_en: As Fear, except that caster may gaze at one target per round.

sp-07978.description_en: As Fear, except for the duration. In addition, if the target fails his Fear RR, that the target will not attempt to attack the caster for I day/10% failuer.

sp-07979.description_en: Target has a fear of a specific type of thing that the caster chooses. The target has a 25% (modified by three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintaining control around the subject. If the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll dlOO (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result ofOl-25 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 26 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-07980.description_en: As Fear, except that this spell is instantaneous.

sp-07981.description_en: As Fear, except for the number of targets.

sp-07982.description_en: As Spook /, except for the number of targets.

sp-07984.description_en: As Terror, except for the number of targets.

sp-07986.description_en: Target believes that everyone is out to get him (including his close associates).

sp-07988.description_en: As Fear, except for the number of targets.

sp-07989.description_en: As Word of Fear, except for the area of effect.

sp-07990.description_en: All within the area are panicked. They will run about screaming and generally doing more harm than good.

sp-07991.description_en: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-07608.description_en: Caster is aware of any Elemental Aether in the area of effect as long as he concentrates.

sp-07609.description_en: Caster channels Elemental Aether energy at the target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 1st level class “E” Nether based spell. The caster must make a successful Targeting maneuver to counter spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster, then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. The target spell receives no RR.

sp-07610.description_en: Target is protected from Elemental Aether, providing a +10 to the target's resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against Aether. This spell also provides a +5 bonus against all other elements except Nether.

sp-07611.description_en: An arc of Aether is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Aether Bolt Attack Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-07612.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of Aether (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Aether critical (no RR).

sp-07613.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 5th level spells.

sp-07615.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 8th level spells.

sp-07616.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of Aether is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Aether Ball Table.

sp-07617.description_en: As Resist Aether, except bonus against Aether is +20 and +10 against all other elements.

sp-07618.description_en: As Aether Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-07619.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 11th level spells.

sp-07620.description_en: As Wall of Aether, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07621.description_en: Caster directs a ray of Aether energy at target non-sentient material. Target material is separated into its base elements (e.g., if a block of stone is disrupted, then it would

sp-07622.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 15th level spells.

sp-07623.description_en: As Aether Ball II, except the radius is 20'.

sp-07624.description_en: As Aether Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-07625.description_en: As Aether Armor I, except the bonus is +20, target takes half damage and critical results are reduced one level in severity. Against all other elements it grants a +20 bonus.

sp-07626.description_en: Caster creates Aether energy within the radius that is non-damaging in nature. This energy will cling to and enhance all elemental attacks through the area. All elemental attacks originating within the radius or passing through the radius deliver double Concussion hit damage and gain a +10 to the attack roll.

sp-07627.description_en: As Counter Nether I, except it affects any level spell. The caster must spend a number of power points 10% higher than the level of the spell to be countered.

sp-07628.description_en: As Aether Armor I, except target is immune to all Aether-based attacks. Against all other elements (except Nether), the target gains a +20 to DB and RR, halves all hits and reduces critical severities by one.

sp-07629.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-07630.description_en: Caster is aware of any elemental Nether in the area of effect as long as he concentrates.

sp-07631.description_en: Caster channels elemental Nether energy at the target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 1st level class “E” based spell of any elemental type except Nether. Caster must make a successful Directed Spells maneuver to counter spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. The target spell receives no RR.

sp-07632.description_en: Target is protected from elemental Nether, providing a +10 to the target's resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against Nether. This spell also provides a +5 bonus against all other elements except Aether.

sp-07633.description_en: An arc of Nether is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Nether Bolt Attack Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-07634.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it affects up to 3rd level spells.

sp-07635.description_en: Target inanimate matter is dissolved completely and reduced to nothingness. If something is held or worn, the item resists at the level of the person holding it. Magic items can resist at the level of their creator.

sp-07636.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of Nether (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Nether critical (no RR).

sp-07637.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it affects of up to 4th level spells.

sp-07638.description_en: A bolt of Nether is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Nether Bolt Table.

sp-07639.description_en: As Nether Resistance, except the bonus against Aether is +20.

sp-07640.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of Nether is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Nether Ball Table.

sp-07641.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it can effect up to 7th level spells.

sp-07643.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it can effect up to 8th level spells.

sp-07644.description_en: As Wall of Nether, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07645.description_en: Caster channels the raw essence of Nether at the target. The target must resist or have his entire body dissolved into nothingness.

sp-07647.description_en: As Nether Armor I, except the bonus is +20; target takes half damage, and critical results are reduced one level in severity.

sp-07649.description_en: Three bolts of Nether are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are within 60º of each other and they are visible to the caster). The caster may apply his directed spell skill (Nether Bolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).

sp-07650.description_en: As Counter Element I, except it will work against any level spell.

sp-07651.description_en: Caster is able to detect all elemental energy forms within range. Energy forms include any manifestation of elemental fire or elemental light. Caster is able to discern whether or not the source is True Elemental Material.

sp-07652.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration of the spell has not expired). See note on light spells.

sp-07653.description_en: For each level of the caster, one cubic foot of liquid can be heated to boiling at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round. There is a 2% chance each round (non-cumulative) that the liquid becomes contaminated and undrinkable, turning into a level 1 ingested poison. The caster will not know that this has happened.

sp-07654.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07655.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Of Essence, section 15.12 for details. Also see note on light spells for this list.

sp-07656.description_en: Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be within 1' of the caster's palm. Targets exposed to wood during ignition are subject to a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07657.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect deepen. This results in a +25 bonus to Hiding maneuvers and +10 to Stalking maneuvers.

sp-07658.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Heat critical (no RR) and a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07659.description_en: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5% failure and must resist against a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07660.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 6 TEP attack.

sp-07661.description_en: As Light I, except the radius is as dark as night.

sp-07662.description_en: As Light I, except radius can be up to 50' (radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-07663.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical and a level 2 TEP attack.

sp-07664.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except range is 300'. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 7 TEP attack.

sp-07665.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 8 TEP attack.

sp-07666.description_en: As Dark I, except radius can be up to 50' (radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-07667.description_en: The caster may designate a type of light source to ignite or extinguish (e.g., candles, torches, fireplaces and lanterns, etc.) This spell will affect all of the light sources of the specified type(s) within the area of effect. Touching a light source at the time of ignition results in a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07668.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except a Lightning Bolt is shot. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 10 TEP attack.

sp-07669.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07670.description_en: This spell is cast in conjunction with any Light or Dark spell (i.e., this spell is cast and then the light/dark spell is cast within 1 minute). It can delay the action of that spell for up to 24 hours. It can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent actions in the area, etc.

sp-07671.description_en: As Fire Bolt I, except range is 300'. The targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 12 TEP attack.

sp-07672.description_en: As Light I, except radius is 100' and caster has the choice of doing darkness or light. If the light version is chosen then the light also nullifies all magically created darkness. If the dark version is chosen then no non-magical light in the radius can exist. Magical darkness or any lights in the radius will return when this spell's duration expires. TEP exposure for either version, occurs every five rounds of continuous exposure. TEP level is 5 for this spell.

sp-07673.description_en: As Lighting Bolt I, except range is 500'. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 20 TEP attack.

sp-07674.description_en: Caster is able to detect all elemental forms of force within range. These forms include any manifestation of elemental air or elemental water. The caster is able to discern whether or not the source is True Elemental Material (TEM).

sp-07675.description_en: Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Water gradually condenses into the caster's hands and may be funneled into any suitable receptacle. There is a 10% chance that the water is turned into a level 1 True elemental poison (TEP).

sp-07676.description_en: Causes a light breeze (up to 20' per round) as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-07677.description_en: Creates dense fog within up to 10'R per level of the caster. See Of Essence, section 15.12 for details. Also see notes for TEP effects.

sp-07678.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. Additionally, those who touch the wall suffer a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07679.description_en: Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. Additionally, those who touch the wall suffer a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07680.description_en: By concentrating, the caster can remove most of the oxygen in the area of effect. After three rounds of concentration, all targets in the area of effect must make an RR each round in the area of effect or fall asleep (1 round per 10 failure). All fire spells in the area suffer a -20 penalty (or at 20% less effective in the case of non-attack spells).

sp-07681.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Water Bolt Attack Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 4 TEP attack.

sp-07682.description_en: Creates a 5'R cloud of charged gas particles. This cloud delivers a 'C' Electricity critical and a level 4 TEP attack to all within the area of effect on the first and second rounds; a 'B' and a level 3 TEP attack on the third and fourth rounds; and an 'A' and a level 2 TEP attack on the fifth and sixth rounds (after 6 rounds, the cloud dissipates.) This cloud drifts with the wind. The cloud takes one round to form (so anyone in the radius when it is cast may make a maneuver to move out of the radius without taking a critical). It will then stay formed for six rounds.

sp-07683.description_en: Disperses any fog in the area of effect. If all of a fog is not dispersed (i.e. the fog covers a greater area than the area of effect for this spell), the fog will refill the area of effect at a rate of 10'R every 1-5 minutes. This spell does not use True Elemental Material and as such does not deliver a TEP attack.

sp-07684.description_en: Stops all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) up to winds of 30 mph; cuts stronger winds by 30 mph. This spell does not deliver any TEP damage.

sp-07685.description_en: As Stun Cloud I, except radius is 10'.

sp-07686.description_en: Creates a 5'R near vacuum. Anyone inside the radius must make a successful resistance roll (RR) or take a 'B' impact critical, as air leaves the radius and comes back in. Those failing their RR also suffer a level 3 TEP attack.

sp-07687.description_en: Water within the radius is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in center and less towards the perimeter.

sp-07688.description_en: As Air Stop I, except radius is 20'.

sp-07689.description_en: As Slumber Mist, except for the duration, and it drifts with the wind.

sp-07690.description_en: True— As Water Wall, except for the duration.

sp-07691.description_en: IV— As Stun Cloud I, except radius is 20'.

sp-07692.description_en: If there are any clouds in the sky, it rains (outdoors) for the duration of the spell. Those in the area who don't have rain gear that would keep the water off their skin will suffer a level 1 TEP attack every minute.

sp-07693.description_en: Caster outstretches arms and then a hard wind comes forth from them, fanning out until it has 25'R at 300'. All within the cone receive a 'B' impact critical and a level 4 TEP attack.

sp-07694.description_en: Caster is aware of all elemental energies, forces, or materials in the area along with its direction and size. Type is unknown.

sp-07695.description_en: Caster analyzes an area for its elemental content. Type of element is known as well as its purity and strength.

sp-07696.description_en: Target gains +20 to their resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against all forms of Fire and Light (elemental or mundane). This will nullify the effects of any slow exposure (like that of a TEM Light spell off of the True Elemental Energy spell list).

sp-07698.description_en: As Resist Energy, except it affects all forms of Earth and Ice (elemental or mundane).

sp-07699.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target manifestation of elemental energy (Fire or Light) must resist or be rapidly diffused into the surrounding environment, making it harmless. This will affect a single spell or up to 10 cu' feet of elemental material.

sp-07700.description_en: Allows caster to see the effects of taint and the level of taint in area focused on. It takes a full minute of concentration to determine the full effects.

sp-07702.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Diffuse Energy, except it affects elemental forms (earth or ice).

sp-07703.description_en: Target who has had corruption due to an elemental attack or True Elemental Poisoning (TEP) may make another resistance roll against the attack at +20. If target fails to resist again, the failure amount may not exceed the original (i.e., make it worse). Damage caused by the original attack still must be healed before any penalties are removed. This spell only affects TEP from fire or light.

sp-07704.description_en: As Remove Energy, except it affects TEP from water or air.

sp-07705.description_en: As Remove Energy, except it affects TEP from ice or earth.

sp-07706.description_en: As Resist Energy, except it affects all who are within 10' of the target.

sp-07708.description_en: As Resist Forms, except it affects all who are within 10' of the target.

sp-07709.description_en: As Remove Energy, except Resistance Roll automatically succeeds.

sp-07714.description_en: If caster holds one end of a rope he can cause it to move up to its length (within the area of effect) in any direction and to tie itself in knots (it cannot attack or tie up a living being).

sp-07715.description_en: For every level of the caster, 1 cubic foot of liquid is cooled to freezing at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round. This will not drop a liquid's temperature below -20˚F (thus, liquids with a freezing point below -20˚F will not freeze). There is a 2% chance each round (non-cumulative) that the liquid becomes contaminated and undrinkable, turning into a level 1 ingested poison. Caster will not know that this has happened.

sp-07716.description_en: Loosens 100 cu' of earth to the consistency of plowed ground. There is a 1% chance that the earth is contaminated with True Elemental Material (TEM). Treat contact as a level 1 True Elemental Poisoning (TEP) attack for the next 10 days.

sp-07717.description_en: Any solid, inanimate, non-metal material can be cooled to -20˚F, at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration. There is a 1% chance that the solid is contaminated with TEM. Treat contact as a level 1 TEP attack for the next 10 days.

sp-07718.description_en: Creates a clear wall of intense cold (up to 10' x 10' x 1'.) Anyone passing through this wall takes an 'A' cold critical (no RR) and a level 3 TEP attack.

sp-07719.description_en: Creates a wall of earth up to 10' x 10' x (3' at the base, 1' at the top). This wall can be dug through. See notes in this spell list.

sp-07720.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10' x 10' x 10' section will extend to their limit. This spell causes no TEP effects.

sp-07721.description_en: As Cool Solid, except material can be cooled to -200˚F, at a rate of 50˚F per round. The caster must concentrate to decrease the temperature (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the duration of the spell).

sp-07722.description_en: The caster may mend a break in a small (up to 2 pounds) inorganic object or multiple breaks, rips or cracks in a larger (up to 10 pounds) organic object. All component parts of the object must be within a 10' radius. There is a 5% chance that the object is contaminated with TEM. Treat contact as a level 1 TEP attack for the next 10 days.

sp-07723.description_en: A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Ice Bolt Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 7 TEP attack.

sp-07724.description_en: As Earth Wall, except wall is up to10' x 10' x 1' of stone. It can be chipped through.

sp-07725.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of cold is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 20'R area. Resolve attack on the Cold Ball Table. Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 8 TEP attack.

sp-07726.description_en: This spell causes the area of effect to bristle with hundreds of 6" to 12" sharp edges and blades. The exact composition of these spikes will depend on the material that the ground is made of. The area of effect must be placed horizontally on a surface (i.e. it cannot be placed on walls.) Most animals and creatures cannot be induced to walk through the area. Anyone moving through the area must make a maneuver roll (at least Extremely Hard difficulty) for every 5' moved through. Anyone who falls inside the area of effect suffers an 'A' puncture critical strike and a level 1 TEP attack.

sp-07727.description_en: Summons a wall of ice up to 10'x10'x (2' at base, 1' at top). It can be melted through or chipped through or toppled (if not against a solid surface). See spell notes for this list.

sp-07728.description_en: Changes 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth or vice versa. This change is gradual (taking three rounds for complete change). There is a 10% chance that the earth (or stone) is contaminated with TEM. Treat contact as a level 1 TEP attack for the next 10 days.

sp-07729.description_en: As Wall of Cold, except it creates a cube of cold (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Cold critical and a level 4 TEP attack

sp-07730.description_en: As Earth Wall, except the duration is permanent.

sp-07731.description_en: As Wall of Cold, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-07732.description_en: For every level of the caster, it changes 10 cubic feet of water to ice, instantly. There is a 10% chance that the liquid becomes contaminated and undrinkable, turning into a level 1 ingested poison if drank or resolve a TEP attack for every 1 minute of contact with ice. Caster will not know that this has happened.

sp-07733.description_en: Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left) 100 cubic feet of earth or stone.

sp-07734.description_en: Three bolts of ice are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are all within 60' of each other; and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill (Ice Bolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB). Targets that are hit for at least one point of damage must resist against a level 15 TEP attack.
